conversation_id TEXT,\n          project_id INTEGER,\n          metadata TEXT,\n          status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n          created_by         "contents": "export class ProjectModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取项目关联的来源信息\n   * 注意：SourceInformation 功能已移除，此方法返回空数组\n   */\n  async getSourceInformations(projectId: number): Promise&lt;SourceInformation[]&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 尝试查询，如果表不存在则返回空数组\n      const sql = &#96;\n        SELECT si.* FROM source_information si\n        INNER JOIN project_source_informations psi ON si.id = psi.source_information_id\n        WHERE psi.project_id = ?\n      &#96;;\n      const result = await this.db.query(sql, [projectId]);\n      return result.map((row: any) =&gt; this.parseSourceInformation(row));\n    } catch (error) {\n      // 如果表不存在或查询失败，返回空数组\n      console.warn('getSourceInformations: SourceInformation table may not exist, returning empty array', error);\n      return [];\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 添加来源信息到项目\n   * 注意：SourceInformation 功能已移除，此方法返回 false\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "// 获取来源信息列表（必须在参数路由之前）\nrouter.get('/', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const page = parseInt(req.query.page as string) || 1;\n    const pageSize = parseInt(req.query.pageSize as string) || 20;\n    const orderBy = req.query.orderBy as string || 'created_at';\n    const orderDirection = (req.query.orderDirection as string || 'DESC').toUpperCase();\n    const pageType = req.query.pageType as string;\n    const conversationId = req.query.conversationId as string;\n    const type = req.query.type as string;\n    const status = req.query.status as string || 'active';\n    const projectId = req.query.projectId ? parseInt(req.query.projectId as string) : undefined;\n\n    // 如果提供了 projectId，使用项目级查询\n    if (projectId) {\n      const sourceInformationList = await sourceInformationService.getSourceInformationByProjectId(projectId);\n      res.json({\n        success: true,\n        data: sourceInformationList,\n        pagination: {\n          page: 1,\n          pageSize: sourceInformationList.length,\n          total: sourceInformationList.length,\n          totalPages: 1\n        }\n      });\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const where: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = {};\n    if (pageType) where.page_type = pageType;\n    if (conversationId) where.conversation_id = conversationId;\n    if (type) where.type = type;\n    if (status) where.status = status;\n\n    const options = {\n      limit: pageSize,\n      offset: (page - 1) * pageSize,\n      orderBy,\n      orderDirection: orderDirection as 'ASC' | 'DESC',\n      where: Object.keys(where).length &gt; 0 ? where : undefined\n    };\n\n    const result = await sourceInformationService.getSourceInformationList(options);\n    \n    res.json({\n      success: true,\n      data: result.data,\n      pagination: {\n        page: result.page,\n        pageSize: result.pageSize,\n        total: result.total,\n        totalPages: result.totalPages\n      }\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('获取来源信息列表失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n\n}",

        "contents": "// 创建来源信息\nrouter.post('/', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const data: CreateSourceInformationDTO = req.body;\n    \n    // 验证必填字段\n    if (!data.source_id || !data.title || !data.type) {\n      return res.status(400).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: 'source_id、title和type为必填字段'\n      });\n    }\n\n    // 验证type字段\n    if (!['knowledge_base', 'external'].includes(data.type)) {\n      return res.status(400).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: 'type必须是knowledge_base或external'\n      });\n    }\n\n    const sourceInformation = await sourceInformationService.createSourceInformation(data);\n    \n    res.status(201).json({\n      success: true,\n      data: sourceInformation,\n      message: '来源信息创建成功'\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('创建来源信息失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      message: '创建来源信息失败',\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// 批量创建来源信息\nrouter.post",

        "contents": "export class SourceInformationModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取所有来源信息\n   */\n  async findAll(options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&lt;PaginatedResult&lt;SourceInformation&gt;&gt; {\n    let sql = 'SELECT * FROM source_information';\n    const values: any[] = [];\n    const conditions: string[] = [];\n\n    // 添加WHERE条件\n    if (options.where) {\n      Object.entries(options.where).forEach(([key, value]) =&gt; {\n        conditions.push(&#96;${key} = ?&#96;);\n        values.push(value);\n      });\n    }\n\n    if (conditions.length &gt; 0) {\n      sql += ' WHERE ' + conditions.join(' AND ');\n    }\n\n    // 添加排序\n    if (options.orderBy) {\n      sql += &#96; ORDER BY ${options.orderBy} ${options.orderDirection || 'ASC'}&#96;;\n    } else {\n      sql += ' ORDER BY created_at DESC';\n    }\n\n    // 获取总数\n    const countSql = sql.replace('SELECT *', 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count');\n    const countResult = await this.db.query(countSql, values);\n    const total = Array.isArray(countResult) ? countResult[0].count : countResult.count;\n\n    // 添加分页\n    if (options.limit) {\n      sql += &#96; LIMIT ${options.limit}&#96;;\n      if (options.offset) {\n        sql += &#96; OFFSET ${options.offset}&#96;;\n      }\n    }\n\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    const rows = Array.isArray(result) ? result : [result];\n    const data = rows.map((row: any) =&gt; this.parseJsonFields(row)) as SourceInformation[];\n    \n    const pageSize = options.limit || total;\n    const page = options.offset ? Math.floor(options.offset / pageSize) + 1 : 1;\n    \n    return {\n      data,\n      total,\n      page,\n      pageSize,\n      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize)\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据对话ID获取来源信息列表\n   */\n  async findByConversationId(conversationId: string): Promise&lt;SourceInformation[]&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "const sourceService = {\n,\n\n  /**\n   * 批量保存来源信息到数据库\n   */\n  async saveSourceInformationBatch(\n    sources: Source[],\n    pageType?: string,\n    conversationId?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;{\n    success: boolean;\n    data?: SourceInformation[];\n    error?: string;\n  }&gt; {\n    try {\n      const sourceInfoList: Partial&lt;SourceInformation&gt;[] = sources.map((source) =&gt; {\n        // 构建 metadata，包含 category\n        const metadata: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = {};\n        if (source.category) {\n          metadata.category = source.category;\n        }\n        \n        return {\n          source_id: source.id,\n          title: source.title,\n          type: source.type,\n          url: source.url,\n          description: source.description,\n          page_type: pageType as any,\n          conversation_id: conversationId,\n          status: \"active\",\n          metadata: Object.keys(metadata).length &gt; 0 ? metadata : undefined,\n        };\n      });\n\n      console.log('[SourceService] 批量保存来源信息:', {\n        count: sourceInfoList.length,\n        pageType,\n        conversationId,\n        sources: sourceInfoList.map(s =&gt; ({ source_id: s.source_id, title: s.title }))\n      });\n\n      const response = await api.post(\"/source-information/batch\", sourceInfoList);\n      const resData = response.data as any;\n      console.log('[SourceService] 批量保存响应:', {\n        success: resData.success,\n        dataCount: resData.data?.length || 0,\n        error: resData.error\n      });\n      \n      return {\n        success: resData.success,\n        data: resData.data,\n        error: resData.error,\n      };\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error(\"[SourceService] 批量保存来源信息失败:\", error);\n      console.error(\"[SourceService] 错误详情:\", {\n        message: error.message,\n        response: error.response?.data,\n        status: error.response?.status\n      });\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        error: error.response?.data?.error || error.message || \"批量保存来源信息失败\",\n      };\n    }\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 根据对话ID加载来源信息\n   */\n  async loadSourceInformationByConversationId(\n    conversationId: string\n  ): Promise&lt;{\n    success: boolean;\n    data?: Source[];\n    error?: string;\n  }&gt; {\n    \n  }\n,\n};",

        "contents": "export class ProjectModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 添加来源信息到项目\n   * 注意：SourceInformation 功能已移除，此方法返回 false\n   */\n  async addSourceInformation(projectId: number, sourceInformationId: number, notes?: string): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n    try {\n      const sql = &#96;\n        INSERT OR IGNORE INTO project_source_informations (project_id, source_information_id, notes)\n        VALUES (?, ?, ?)\n      &#96;;\n      const result = await this.db.query(sql, [projectId, sourceInformationId, notes || null]);\n      return (result as any).changes &gt; 0 || (result as any).lastID !== undefined;\n    } catch (error) {\n      // 如果表不存在或操作失败，返回 false\n      console.warn('addSourceInformation: SourceInformation table may not exist, returning false', error);\n      return false;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 从项目移除来源信息\n   * 注意：SourceInformation 功能已移除，此方法返回 false\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "# 项目资源关联设计文档\n\n## 一、数据库设计\n\n### 1. 来源信息表 (source_information)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS source_information (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    source_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    title TEXT NOT NULL,\n    type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('knowledge_base', 'external')),\n    url TEXT,\n    description TEXT,\n    page_type TEXT CHECK (page_type IN ('tech-package', 'press-release', 'tech-strategy', 'tech-article')),\n    conversation_id TEXT,\n    project_id INTEGER, -- 关联的项目ID（主要关联方式）\n    metadata TEXT, -- JSON格式，包含 category 等信息\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active',\n    created_by TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\n);\n\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_project_id ON source_information(project_id);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**关键字段说明：**\n- &#96;project_id&#96;: 直接关联项目，这是主要的关联方式\n- &#96;page_type&#96;: 仅用于标识页面类型，不再包含项目ID\n- &#96;metadata&#96;: JSON格式，包含 &#96;category&#96; 等信息，用于资源分类\n\n### 2. 项目与来源信息关联表 (project_source_informations)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_source_informations (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    source_information_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (source_information_id) REFERENCES source_information(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(project_id, source_information_id)\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**用途：**\n- 支持多对多关系（一个来源可以关联多个项目）\n- 作为 &#96;project_id&#96; 字段的补充关联方式\n- 兼容旧数据（通过 page_type 关联的项目）\n\n## 二、项目关联机制\n\n### 1. 创建来源信息时的关联",

已优化“编辑来源”弹窗，主要改进如下：

## 主要优化内容

### 1. **UI 改进**
- 头部显示类别图标和颜色
- 来源类型和类别分开展示，更清晰
- 优化表单布局和间距

### 2. **字段验证**
- URL 格式验证（可选字段）
- 标题必填验证
- 实时错误提示

### 3. **选项信息**
- 项目选择显示项目描述（如有）
- 来源类型和类别使用图标和颜色标识
- 为各字段添加帮助文本

### 4. **交互**
- 保存时显示加载状态
- 点击遮罩层可关闭弹窗
- 按钮禁用状态优化
- 显示元信息（创建时间、创建人）

### 5. **细节**
- 实时清除错误提示
- 优化字段占位符和提示文本
- URL 字段添加格式提示

弹窗已更清晰、易用，信息展示更完整。

        "contents": "export class ProjectModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取所有项目\n   */\n  async findAll(options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&lt;PaginatedResult&lt;Project&gt;&gt; {\n    let sql = 'SELECT * FROM projects';\n    const values: any[] = [];\n    const conditions: string[] = [];\n\n    // 添加WHERE条件\n    if (options.where) {\n      Object.entries(options.where).forEach(([key, value]) =&gt; {\n        if (value === null) {\n          conditions.push(&#96;${key} IS NULL&#96;);\n        } else {\n          conditions.push(&#96;${key} = ?&#96;);\n          values.push(value);\n        }\n      });\n    }\n\n    if (conditions.length &gt; 0) {\n      sql += ' WHERE ' + conditions.join(' AND ');\n    }\n\n    // 添加排序\n    if (options.orderBy) {\n      sql += &#96; ORDER BY ${options.orderBy} ${options.orderDirection || 'ASC'}&#96;;\n    } else {\n      sql += ' ORDER BY created_at DESC';\n    }\n\n    // 获取总数\n    const countSql = sql.replace('SELECT *', 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count');\n    const countResult = await this.db.query(countSql, values);\n    const total = countResult[0].count;\n\n    // 添加分页\n    if (options.limit) {\n      sql += &#96; LIMIT ${options.limit}&#96;;\n      if (options.offset) {\n        sql += &#96; OFFSET ${options.offset}&#96;;\n      }\n    }\n\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    const data = result.map((row: any) =&gt; this.parseRow(row)) as Project[];\n    \n    const pageSize = options.limit || total;\n    const page = options.offset ? Math.floor(options.offset / pageSize) + 1 : 1;\n    \n    return {\n      data,\n      total,\n      page,\n      pageSize,\n      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize)\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取精选项目\n   */\n  async findFeatured(limit: number = 10): Promise&lt;Project[]&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      SELECT * FROM projects \n      WHERE type = ? AND status = ?\n      ORDER BY created_at DESC\n      LIMIT ?\n    &#96;;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "const ProjectManagementPage: React.FC = \n\n [searchParams, projectId]);\n\n  const handleAddTechPointsFromLibrary = async (selectedTechPointIdsStr: string) =&gt; {\n    if (!projectId) return;\n\n    const techPointIds = selectedTechPointIdsStr\n      .split(',')\n      .map(id =&gt; parseInt(id.trim(), 10))\n      .filter(id =&gt; !isNaN(id));\n\n    if (techPointIds.length === 0) {\n      // 清除 URL 参数\n      setSearchParams({});\n      return;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      let successCount = 0;\n      let failCount = 0;\n\n      // 批量添加技术点到项目\n      for (const techPointId of techPointIds) {\n        try {\n          const response = await api.post(&#96;/projects/${projectId}/relations&#96;, {\n            relationType: 'tech_point',\n            relationId: techPointId\n          });\n\n          if (response.data?.success) {\n            successCount++;\n          } else {\n            failCount++;\n          }\n        } catch (error) {\n          console.error(&#96;添加技术点 ${techPointId} 失败:&#96;, error);\n          failCount++;\n        }\n      }\n\n      // 清除 URL 参数\n      setSearchParams({});\n\n      // 显示结果消息\n      if (successCount &gt; 0) {\n        message.success(&#96;成功添加 ${successCount} 个技术点到项目&#96;);\n        // 刷新技术点列表\n        setTechPointListRefreshTrigger(prev =&gt; prev + 1);\n      }\n      if (failCount &gt; 0) {\n        message.warning(&#96;${failCount} 个技术点添加失败，可能已存在&#96;);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('添加技术点失败:', error);\n      message.error('添加技术点失败');\n      // 清除 URL 参数\n      setSearchParams({});\n    }\n  };\n\n  const loadProject = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!projectId) return;\n\n    try {\n      setLoading(true);\n      const response = await projectService.getProjectById(parseInt(projectId));\n      if (response.success &amp;&amp; response.data) {\n        setProject(response.data);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载项目失败:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleSelectTechPoint = (techPoint: TechPoint) =&gt;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "-- 项目表\n-- 用于存储项目信息\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS projects (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    description TEXT,\n    cover_image TEXT,\n    icon TEXT,\n    type TEXT DEFAULT 'normal' CHECK (type IN ('normal', 'featured')),\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n    created_by TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    last_opened_at DATETIME\n);\n\n-- 项目来源表\n-- 用于关联项目与各种来源（文件、URL、文本、技术点等）\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_sources (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    source_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_type IN ('file', 'url', 'text', 'tech_point', 'knowledge_point')),\n    source_content TEXT NOT NULL,\n    source_title TEXT,\n    source_description TEXT,\n    metadata TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 创建索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_type ON projects(type);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_status ON projects(status);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_created_at ON projects(created_at);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_last_opened_at ON projects(last_opened_at);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_project_sources_project_id ON project_sources(project_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_project_sources_source_type ON project_sources(source_type);",

### 3. **用户体验优化**

已根据类别调整来源类型的显示逻辑。主要改动：

## 优化内容

### 1. **新增来源类型判断函数**
- 创建 `getSourceTypeByCategory`，根据类别判断显示“内容信息”或“外部来源”
- 内容信息类别：技术转译、AI问答总结、技术包装问答、技术策略问答、技术通稿问答
- 外部来源类别：互联网搜索、Web搜索、外部来源

### 2. **优化来源类型显示**
- 根据类别动态显示“内容信息”或“外部来源”
- “内容信息”使用蓝色主题和 Brain 图标
- “外部来源”使用灰色主题和 FileText 图标
- 保持与来源类别的视觉区分

### 3. **显示逻辑**
- 来源类型：根据类别显示“内容信息”或“外部来源”
- 来源类别：显示具体类别（如“AI问答总结”、“Web搜索”等）

现在编辑来源弹窗中：
- AI问答总结、技术转译等显示为“内容信息”
- Web搜索、互联网搜索等显示为“外部来源”
- 两种类型有明确的视觉区分

来源类型显示已按类别正确分类。

        "contents": "export class SourceInformationModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 更新来源信息\n   */\n  async update(id: number, data: UpdateSourceInformationDTO): Promise&lt;SourceInformation | null&gt; {\n    const fields: string[] = [];\n    const values: any[] = [];\n\n    Object.entries(data).forEach(([key, value]) =&gt; {\n      if (value !== undefined) {\n        if (key === 'metadata') {\n          fields.push(&#96;${key} = ?&#96;);\n          values.push(JSON.stringify(value));\n        } else {\n          fields.push(&#96;${key} = ?&#96;);\n          values.push(value);\n        }\n      }\n    });\n\n    if (fields.length === 0) {\n      return this.findById(id);\n    }\n\n    values.push(id);\n    \n    const sql = &#96;\n      UPDATE source_information \n      SET ${fields.join(', ')}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n      WHERE id = ?\n    &#96;;\n\n    await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    return this.findById(id);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据source_id更新来源信息\n   */\n  async updateBySourceId(sourceId: string, data: UpdateSourceInformationDTO): Promise&lt;SourceInformation | null&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class SourceInformationService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 创建来源信息\n   */\n  async createSourceInformation(data: CreateSourceInformationDTO): Promise&lt;SourceInformation&gt; {\n    // 检查source_id是否已存在（只检查活跃状态的记录）\n    const existing = await this.model.findBySourceId(data.source_id);\n    if (existing &amp;&amp; existing.status === 'active') {\n      // 如果已存在且是活跃状态，更新而不是创建\n      const updated = await this.model.updateBySourceId(data.source_id, data);\n      if (!updated) {\n        throw new Error('更新来源信息失败');\n      }\n      \n      // 如果提供了 project_id，确保关联存在\n      if (data.project_id &amp;&amp; updated.id) {\n        await this.model.createProjectAssociation(data.project_id, updated.id);\n      }\n      \n      return updated;\n    }\n    \n    // 如果记录不存在或者是已删除状态，创建新记录\n    // 如果已删除的记录存在，先物理删除它，然后创建新记录\n    if (existing &amp;&amp; existing.status === 'deleted') {\n      // 物理删除已删除的记录，避免重复\n      await this.model.hardDelete(existing.id);\n    }\n    \n    const created = await this.model.create(data);\n    \n    // 如果提供了 project_id，创建项目关联\n    if (data.project_id &amp;&amp; created.id) {\n      await this.model.createProjectAssociation(data.project_id, created.id);\n    }\n    \n    return created;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID获取来源信息\n   */\n  async getSourceInformationById(id: number): Promise&lt;SourceInformation | null&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "// 创建来源信息\nrouter.post('/', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const data: CreateSourceInformationDTO = req.body;\n    \n    // 验证必填字段\n    if (!data.source_id || !data.title || !data.type) {\n      return res.status(400).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: 'source_id、title和type为必填字段'\n      });\n    }\n\n    // 验证type字段\n    if (!['knowledge_base', 'external'].includes(data.type)) {\n      return res.status(400).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: 'type必须是knowledge_base或external'\n      });\n    }\n\n    const sourceInformation = await sourceInformationService.createSourceInformation(data);\n    \n    res.status(201).json({\n      success: true,\n      data: sourceInformation,\n      message: '来源信息创建成功'\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('创建来源信息失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      message: '创建来源信息失败',\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// 批量创建来源信息\nrouter.post",

        "contents": "const sourceService = {\n,\n\n  /**\n   * 保存来源信息到数据库\n   */\n  async saveSourceInformation(\n    source: Source,\n    pageType?: string,\n    conversationId?: string,\n    projectId?: number\n  ): Promise&lt;{\n    success: boolean;\n    data?: SourceInformation;\n    error?: string;\n  }&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 构建 metadata，包含 category\n      const metadata: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = {};\n      if (source.category) {\n        metadata.category = source.category;\n      }\n      \n      const sourceInfo: Partial&lt;SourceInformation&gt; = {\n        source_id: source.id,\n        title: source.title,\n        type: source.type,\n        url: source.url,\n        description: source.description,\n        page_type: pageType as any,\n        conversation_id: conversationId,\n        project_id: projectId,\n        status: \"active\",\n        metadata: Object.keys(metadata).length &gt; 0 ? metadata : undefined,\n      };\n\n      const response = await api.post(\"/source-information\", sourceInfo);\n      const resData = response.data as any;\n      return {\n        success: resData.success,\n        data: resData.data,\n        error: resData.error,\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"保存来源信息失败:\", error);\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        error: \"保存来源信息失败\",\n      };\n    }\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 批量保存来源信息到数据库\n   */\n  async saveSourceInformationBatch(\n    sources: Source[],\n    pageType?: string,\n    conversationId?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;{\n    success: boolean;\n    data?: SourceInformation[];\n    error?: string;\n  }&gt; {\n    \n  }\n,\n};",

        "contents": "// 获取来源信息列表（必须在参数路由之前）\nrouter.get('/', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const page = parseInt(req.query.page as string) || 1;\n    const pageSize = parseInt(req.query.pageSize as string) || 20;\n    const orderBy = req.query.orderBy as string || 'created_at';\n    const orderDirection = (req.query.orderDirection as string || 'DESC').toUpperCase();\n    const pageType = req.query.pageType as string;\n    const conversationId = req.query.conversationId as string;\n    const type = req.query.type as string;\n    const status = req.query.status as string || 'active';\n    const projectId = req.query.projectId ? parseInt(req.query.projectId as string) : undefined;\n\n    // 如果提供了 projectId，使用项目级查询\n    if (projectId) {\n      const sourceInformationList = await sourceInformationService.getSourceInformationByProjectId(projectId);\n      res.json({\n        success: true,\n        data: sourceInformationList,\n        pagination: {\n          page: 1,\n          pageSize: sourceInformationList.length,\n          total: sourceInformationList.length,\n          totalPages: 1\n        }\n      });\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const where: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = {};\n    if (pageType) where.page_type = pageType;\n    if (conversationId) where.conversation_id = conversationId;\n    if (type) where.type = type;\n    if (status) where.status = status;\n\n    const options = {\n      limit: pageSize,\n      offset: (page - 1) * pageSize,\n      orderBy,\n      orderDirection: orderDirection as 'ASC' | 'DESC',\n      where: Object.keys(where).length &gt; 0 ? where : undefined\n    };\n\n    const result = await sourceInformationService.getSourceInformationList(options);\n    \n    res.json({\n      success: true,\n      data: result.data,\n      pagination: {\n        page: result.page,\n        pageSize: result.pageSize,\n        total: result.total,\n        totalPages: result.totalPages\n      }\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('获取来源信息列表失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n\n}",

        "contents": "-- 来源信息表\n-- 用于存储通过 SourceSidebar 添加的信息（包括文本来源和外部来源）\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS source_information (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    source_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COMMENT '来源唯一标识（前端生成的ID）',\n    title TEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '来源标题',\n    type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('knowledge_base', 'external')) COMMENT '来源类型：knowledge_base=知识库，external=外部来源',\n    url TEXT COMMENT '外部来源URL（仅external类型）',\n    description TEXT COMMENT '来源描述/内容',\n    page_type TEXT COMMENT '页面类型：tech-package, press-release, tech-strategy, tech-article',\n    conversation_id TEXT COMMENT '关联的对话ID',\n    metadata TEXT COMMENT '元数据（JSON格式）',\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')) COMMENT '状态',\n    created_by TEXT COMMENT '创建人',\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 创建索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_source_id ON source_information(source_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_type ON source_information(type);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_page_type ON source_information(page_type);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_conversation_id ON source_information(conversation_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_status ON source_information(status);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_created_at ON source_information(created_at);",

        "contents": "const sourceService = {\n,\n\n  /**\n   * 批量保存来源信息到数据库\n   */\n  async saveSourceInformationBatch(\n    sources: Source[],\n    pageType?: string,\n    conversationId?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;{\n    success: boolean;\n    data?: SourceInformation[];\n    error?: string;\n  }&gt; {\n    try {\n      const sourceInfoList: Partial&lt;SourceInformation&gt;[] = sources.map((source) =&gt; {\n        // 构建 metadata，包含 category\n        const metadata: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = {};\n        if (source.category) {\n          metadata.category = source.category;\n        }\n        \n        return {\n          source_id: source.id,\n          title: source.title,\n          type: source.type,\n          url: source.url,\n          description: source.description,\n          page_type: pageType as any,\n          conversation_id: conversationId,\n          status: \"active\",\n          metadata: Object.keys(metadata).length &gt; 0 ? metadata : undefined,\n        };\n      });\n\n      console.log('[SourceService] 批量保存来源信息:', {\n        count: sourceInfoList.length,\n        pageType,\n        conversationId,\n        sources: sourceInfoList.map(s =&gt; ({ source_id: s.source_id, title: s.title }))\n      });\n\n      const response = await api.post(\"/source-information/batch\", sourceInfoList);\n      const resData = response.data as any;\n      console.log('[SourceService] 批量保存响应:', {\n        success: resData.success,\n        dataCount: resData.data?.length || 0,\n        error: resData.error\n      });\n      \n      return {\n        success: resData.success,\n        data: resData.data,\n        error: resData.error,\n      };\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error(\"[SourceService] 批量保存来源信息失败:\", error);\n      console.error(\"[SourceService] 错误详情:\", {\n        message: error.message,\n        response: error.response?.data,\n        status: error.response?.status\n      });\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        error: error.response?.data?.error || error.message || \"批量保存来源信息失败\",\n      };\n    }\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 根据对话ID加载来源信息\n   */\n  async loadSourceInformationByConversationId(\n    conversationId: string\n  ): Promise&lt;{\n    success: boolean;\n    data?: Source[];\n    error?: string;\n  }&gt; {\n    \n  }\n,\n};",

        "contents": "// 批量创建来源信息\nrouter.post('/batch', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const dataList: CreateSourceInformationDTO[] = req.body;\n    \n    if (!Array.isArray(dataList) || dataList.length === 0) {\n      return res.status(400).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '请提供有效的来源信息数组'\n      });\n    }\n\n    // 验证每个数据项\n    for (const data of dataList) {\n      if (!data.source_id || !data.title || !data.type) {\n        return res.status(400).json({\n          success: false,\n          message: '每个来源信息必须包含source_id、title和type字段'\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    const results = await sourceInformationService.createSourceInformationBatch(dataList);\n    \n    res.status(201).json({\n      success: true,\n      data: results,\n      message: &#96;成功创建${results.length}条来源信息&#96;\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('批量创建来源信息失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      message: '批量创建来源信息失败',\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// 获取来源信息列表（必须在参数路由之前）\nrouter.get",

        "contents": "// 根据项目ID获取来源信息列表（必须在 /:id 之前）\nrouter.get('/project/:projectId', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    // 确保表已初始化\n    try {\n      await sourceInformationService.initializeTable();\n    } catch (initError: any) {\n      // 如果表已存在，忽略错误\n      if (!initError?.message?.includes('already exists') &amp;&amp; \n          !initError?.message?.includes('duplicate')) {\n        console.warn('初始化表时出现警告，继续执行:', initError?.message);\n      }\n    }\n\n    const projectId = parseInt(req.params.projectId);\n    \n    if (isNaN(projectId)) {\n      return res.status(400).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '无效的项目ID'\n      });\n    }\n\n    const sourceInformationList = await sourceInformationService.getSourceInformationByProjectId(projectId);\n    \n    res.json({\n      success: true,\n      data: sourceInformationList\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('获取项目来源信息列表失败:', error);\n    console.error('错误详情:', error instanceof Error ? error.stack : error);\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      message: '获取项目来源信息列表失败',\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// 根据页面类型获取来源信息列表（必须在 /:id 之前）\nrouter.get",

        "contents": "// 根据ID获取来源信息（必须在最后，因为会匹配任何路径）\nrouter.get('/:id', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const id = parseInt(req.params.id);\n    \n    if (isNaN(id)) {\n      return res.status(400).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '无效的来源信息ID'\n      });\n    }\n\n    const sourceInformation = await sourceInformationService.getSourceInformationById(id);\n    \n    if (!sourceInformation) {\n      return res.status(404).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '来源信息不存在'\n      });\n    }\n    \n    res.json({\n      success: true,\n      data: sourceInformation\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('获取来源信息失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      message: '获取来源信息失败',\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// 更新来源信息\nrouter.put('/:id',",

        "contents": "export class SourceInformationModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 创建来源信息\n   */\n  async create(data: CreateSourceInformationDTO): Promise&lt;SourceInformation&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      INSERT INTO source_information (\n        source_id, title, type, url, description, page_type, \n        conversation_id, project_id, metadata, status, created_by\n      )\n      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const values = [\n      data.source_id,\n      data.title,\n      data.type,\n      data.url || null,\n      data.description || null,\n      data.page_type || null,\n      data.conversation_id || null,\n      data.project_id || null,\n      data.metadata ? JSON.stringify(data.metadata) : null,\n      data.status || 'active',\n      data.created_by || null\n    ];\n\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    const id = result.lastID || result.insertId;\n    \n    const sourceInfo = await this.findById(id);\n    if (!sourceInfo) {\n      throw new Error('Failed to create source information');\n    }\n    \n    return sourceInfo;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID获取来源信息\n   */\n  async findById(id: number): Promise&lt;SourceInformation | null&gt; {\n    const sql = 'SELECT * FROM source_information WHERE id = ?';\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class SourceInformationModel {\nasync findByPageType(pageType: string): Promise&lt;SourceInformation[]&gt; {\n\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据项目ID获取来源信息列表\n   * 支持三种方式：\n   * 1. 通过 project_id 字段查询（主要方式）\n   * 2. 通过关联表 project_source_informations 查询（补充方式）\n   * 3. 通过 page_type = 'project-{projectId}' 查询（兼容旧数据）\n   */\n  async findByProjectId(projectId: number): Promise&lt;SourceInformation[]&gt; {\n    const pageType = &#96;project-${projectId}&#96;;\n    const results: SourceInformation[] = [];\n    const seenIds = new Set&lt;number&gt;();\n    \n    try {\n      // 方式1: 通过 project_id 字段查询\n      try {\n        const sql1 = &#96;\n          SELECT * FROM source_information\n          WHERE project_id = ? AND status = 'active'\n          ORDER BY created_at DESC\n        &#96;;\n        const result1 = await this.db.query(sql1, [projectId]);\n        const rows1 = Array.isArray(result1) ? result1 : [result1];\n        for (const row of rows1) {\n          const parsed = this.parseJsonFields(row) as SourceInformation;\n          if (parsed.id &amp;&amp; !seenIds.has(parsed.id)) {\n            results.push(parsed);\n            seenIds.add(parsed.id);\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        // 如果 project_id 字段不存在，忽略错误\n        if (!error?.message?.includes('no such column: project_id') &amp;&amp; \n            !error?.message?.includes('column \"project_id\" does not exist')) {\n          console.warn('查询 project_id 字段失败:', error?.message);\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // 方式2: 通过关联表查询\n      try\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class SourceInformationService {\nconstructor() {\n\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 初始化数据库表\n   */\n  async initializeTable(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    try {\n      // SQLite 需要逐个执行语句\n      const statements = [\n        &#96;CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS source_information (\n          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n          source_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n          title TEXT NOT NULL,\n          type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('knowledge_base', 'external')),\n          url TEXT,\n          description TEXT,\n          page_type TEXT,\n          conversation_id TEXT,\n          project_id INTEGER,\n          metadata TEXT,\n          status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n          created_by TEXT,\n          created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n          updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n        )&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_source_id ON source_information(source_id)&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_type ON source_information(type)&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_page_type ON source_information(page_type)&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_conversation_id ON source_information(conversation_id)&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_project_id ON source_information(project_id)&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_status ON source_information(status)&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_created_at ON source_information(created_at)&#96;,\n        // 创建项目与来源信息关联表\n        &#96;CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_source_informations (\n          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n          project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n          source_information_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n          notes TEXT,\n          created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n          updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n          UNIQUE(project_id, source_information_id)\n        )&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_project_source_informations_project_id ON project_source_informations(project_id)&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_project_source_informations_source_information_id ON project_source_informations(source_information_id)\n      ];\n  }\n}",

parseInt(req.query.projectId as string) : undefined;\n\n    // 如果提供了 projectId，使用项目级查询\n    if (projectId) {\n      const sourceInformationList = await sourceInformationService.getSourceInformationByProjectId(projectId);\n      res.json({\n        success: true,\n        data: sourceInformationList,\n        pagination: {\n          page: 1,\n          pageSize: sourceInformationList.length,\n          total: sourceInformationList.length,\n          totalPages: 1\n        }\n      });\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const where: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = {};\n    if (pageType) where.page_type = pageType;\n    if (conversationId) where.conversation_id = conversationId;\n    if (type) where.type = type;\n    if (status) where.status = status;\n\n    const options = {\n      limit: pageSize,\n      offset: (page - 1) * pageSize,\n      orderBy,\n      orderDirection: orderDirection as 'ASC' | 'DESC',\n      where: Object.keys(where).length &gt; 0 ? where : undefined\n    };\n\n    const result = await sourceInformationService.getSourceInformationList(options);\n    \n    res.json({\n      success: true,\n      data: result.data,\n      pagination: {\n        page: result.page,\n        pageSize: result.pageSize,\n        total: result.total,\n        totalPages: result.totalPages\n      }\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('获取来源信息列表失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n\n}",

        "contents": "// 根据source_id更新来源信息\nrouter.put('/source-id/:sourceId', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const { sourceId } = req.params;\n    const data: UpdateSourceInformationDTO = req.body;\n\n    const sourceInformation = await sourceInformationService.updateSourceInformationBySourceId(sourceId, data);\n    \n    if (!sourceInformation) {\n      return res.status(404).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '来源信息不存在'\n      });\n    }\n    \n    res.json({\n      success: true,\n      data: sourceInformation,\n      message: '来源信息更新成功'\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('更新来源信息失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      message: '更新来源信息失败',\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// 删除来源信息\nrouter.delete('/:id',",

        "contents": "export class SourceInformationModel {\nasync findByProjectId(projectId: number): Promise&lt;SourceInformation[]&gt; {\n\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // 方式2: 通过关联表查询\n      try {\n        const sql2 = &#96;\n          SELECT si.* FROM source_information si\n          INNER JOIN project_source_informations psi ON si.id = psi.source_information_id\n          WHERE psi.project_id = ? AND si.status = 'active'\n          ORDER BY si.created_at DESC\n        &#96;;\n        const result2 = await this.db.query(sql2, [projectId]);\n        const rows2 = Array.isArray(result2) ? result2 : [result2];\n        for (const row of rows2) {\n          const parsed = this.parseJsonFields(row) as SourceInformation;\n          if (parsed.id &amp;&amp; !seenIds.has(parsed.id)) {\n            results.push(parsed);\n            seenIds.add(parsed.id);\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        // 如果关联表不存在，忽略错误\n        if (!error?.message?.includes('no such table: project_source_informations') &amp;&amp;\n            !error?.message?.includes('relation \"project_source_informations\" does not exist')) {\n          console.warn('查询关联表失败:', error?.message);\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // 方式3: 通过 page_type 查询（兼容旧数据）\n      try {\n        const sql3 = &#96;\n          SELECT * FROM source_information\n          WHERE page_type = ?         },
        "contents": "export class SourceInformationService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 创建来源信息\n   */\n  async createSourceInformation(data: CreateSourceInformationDTO): Promise&lt;SourceInformation&gt; {\n    // 检查source_id是否已存在（只检查活跃状态的记录）\n    const existing = await this.model.findBySourceId(data.source_id);\n    if (existing &amp;&amp; existing.status === 'active') {\n      // 如果已存在且是活跃状态，更新而不是创建\n      const updated = await this.model.updateBySourceId(data.source_id, data);\n      if (!updated) {\n        throw new Error('更新来源信息失败');\n      }\n      \n      // 如果提供了 project_id，确保关联存在\n      if (data.project_id &amp;&amp; updated.id) {\n        await this.model.createProjectAssociation(data.project_id, updated.id);\n      }\n      \n      return updated;\n    }\n    \n    // 如果记录不存在或者是已删除状态，创建新记录\n    // 如果已删除的记录存在，先物理删除它，然后创建新记录\n    if (existing &amp;&amp; existing.status === 'deleted') {\n      // 物理删除已删除的记录，避免重复\n      await this.model.hardDelete(existing.id);\n    }\n    \n    const created = await this.model.create(data);\n    \n    // 如果提供了 project_id，创建项目关联\n    if (data.project_id &amp;&amp; created.id) {\n      await this.model.createProjectAssociation(data.project_id, created.id);\n    }\n    \n    return created;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID获取来源信息\n   */\n  async getSourceInformationById(id: number): Promise&lt;SourceInformation | null&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "// 创建来源信息\nrouter.post('/', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const data: CreateSourceInformationDTO = req.body;\n    \n    // 验证必填字段\n    if (!data.source_id || !data.title || !data.type) {\n      return res.status(400).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: 'source_id、title和type为必填字段'\n      });\n    }\n\n    // 验证type字段\n    if (!['knowledge_base', 'external'].includes(data.type)) {\n      return res.status(400).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: 'type必须是knowledge_base或external'\n      });\n    }\n\n    const sourceInformation = await sourceInformationService.createSourceInformation(data);\n    \n    res.status(201).json({\n      success: true,\n      data: sourceInformation,\n      message: '来源信息创建成功'\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('创建来源信息失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      message: '创建来源信息失败',\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// 批量创建来源信息\nrouter.post",

        "contents": "// 根据项目ID获取来源信息列表（必须在 /:id 之前）\nrouter.get('/project/:projectId', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    // 确保表已初始化\n    try {\n      await sourceInformationService.initializeTable();\n    } catch (initError: any) {\n      // 如果表已存在，忽略错误\n      if (!initError?.message?.includes('already exists') &amp;&amp; \n          !initError?.message?.includes('duplicate')) {\n        console.warn('初始化表时出现警告，继续执行:', initError?.message);\n      }\n    }\n\n    const projectId = parseInt(req.params.projectId);\n    \n    if (isNaN(projectId)) {\n      return res.status(400).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '无效的项目ID'\n      });\n    }\n\n    const sourceInformationList = await sourceInformationService.getSourceInformationByProjectId(projectId);\n    \n    res.json({\n      success: true,\n      data: sourceInformationList\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('获取项目来源信息列表失败:', error);\n    console.error('错误详情:', error instanceof Error ? error.stack : error);\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      message: '获取项目来源信息列表失败',\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// 根据页面类型获取来源信息列表（必须在 /:id 之前）\nrouter.get",

        "contents": "export class ProjectModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取项目关联的来源信息\n   * 注意：SourceInformation 功能已移除，此方法返回空数组\n   */\n  async getSourceInformations(projectId: number): Promise&lt;SourceInformation[]&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 尝试查询，如果表不存在则返回空数组\n      const sql = &#96;\n        SELECT si.* FROM source_information si\n        INNER JOIN project_source_informations psi ON si.id = psi.source_information_id\n        WHERE psi.project_id = ?\n      &#96;;\n      const result = await this.db.query(sql, [projectId]);\n      return result.map((row: any) =&gt; this.parseSourceInformation(row));\n    } catch (error) {\n      // 如果表不存在或查询失败，返回空数组\n      console.warn('getSourceInformations: SourceInformation table may not exist, returning empty array', error);\n      return [];\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 添加来源信息到项目\n   * 注意：SourceInformation 功能已移除，此方法返回 false\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "-- 来源信息项目关联迁移脚本\n-- 创建日期: 2025-01-XX\n-- 说明: 将来源信息从 page_type 维度迁移到项目维度\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 1. 添加 project_id 字段到 source_information 表\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 检查并添加 project_id 字段（SQLite 不支持 IF NOT EXISTS，需要先检查）\n-- 如果字段已存在，此操作会失败，需要在应用层处理\n\n-- 添加 project_id 字段\nALTER TABLE source_information ADD COLUMN project_id INTEGER;\n\n-- 创建索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_project_id ON source_information(project_id);\n\n-- 添加外键约束（SQLite 3.37.0+ 支持，旧版本可能需要重建表）\n-- 注意：SQLite 的 ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN 不支持直接添加外键\n-- 如果需要外键约束，需要重建表，这里先添加字段，外键约束在应用层处理\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 2. 从 page_type 中提取项目 ID 并更新 project_id\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 更新 project_id：从 page_type 中提取项目ID\n-- 格式: tech-package-project-123, tech-strategy-project-456 等\nUPDATE source_information\nSET project_id = CAST(\n  SUBSTR(\n    page_type,\n    INSTR(page_type, 'project-') + 8\n  ) AS INTEGER\n)\nWHERE page_type LIKE '%-project-%'\n  AND project_id IS NULL;\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 3. 清理 page_type 字段，保留标准格式\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 将 tech-package-project-123 格式转换为 tech-package\nUPDATE source_information\nSET page_type = SUBSTR(page_type, 1, INSTR(page_type, '-project-') - 1)\nWHERE page_type LIKE '%-project-%'\n  AND INSTR(page_type, '-project-') &gt; 0;\n\n-- 将 tech-strategy-project-123 格式转换为 tech-strategy\n-- 注意：上面的 UPDATE 已经处理了所有 -project- 的情况\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 4. 在 project_source_informations 表中建立关联\n-- ==============================================",

        "contents": "-- 项目关联表创建脚本\n-- 用于关联项目与技术点、知识点、文件等资源\n\n-- 项目与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(project_id, tech_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 项目与知识点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_knowledge_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    knowledge_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (knowledge_point_id) REFERENCES knowledge_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(project_id, knowledge_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 项目与文件关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_files (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    file_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (file_id) REFERENCES files(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(project_id, file_id)\n);\n\n-- 创建索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_project_tech_points_project_id ON project_tech_points(project_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_project_tech_points_tech_point_id ON project_tech_points(tech_point_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_project_knowledge_points_project_id ON project_knowledge_points(project_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_project_knowledge_points_knowledge_point_id ON project_knowledge_points(knowledge_point_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_project_files_project_id ON project_files(project_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_project_files_file_id ON project_files(file_id);",

        "contents": "/**\n * 修复项目关联关系脚本\n * 确保所有关联表都存在且 conversations 表有 project_id 字段\n */\n\nimport { getDatabaseManager } from '../config/database';\nimport { logger } from '../shared/lib/logger';\nimport * as fs from 'fs';\nimport * as path from 'path';\n\nasync function fixProjectRelations() {\n  const db = getDatabaseManager();\n  \n  try {\n    await db.connect();\n    logger.info('开始修复项目关联关系...');\n\n    // 1. 确保 conversations 表有 project_id 字段\n    logger.info('检查并修复 conversations 表...');\n    try {\n      const hasProjectId = await checkColumnExists(db, 'conversations', 'project_id');\n      if (!hasProjectId) {\n        logger.info('为 conversations 表添加 project_id 字段...');\n        await db.query('ALTER TABLE conversations ADD COLUMN project_id INTEGER');\n        logger.info('✓ 已添加 project_id 字段');\n      } else {\n        logger.info('✓ conversations 表已有 project_id 字段');\n      }\n\n      // 创建索引\n      await db.query(&#96;\n        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_conversations_project_id ON conversations(project_id)\n      &#96;);\n      logger.info('✓ 已创建索引');\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      if (error.message?.includes('duplicate column') || error.message?.includes('already exists')) {\n        logger.info('✓ project_id 字段已存在');\n      } else {\n        logger.error('修复 conversations 表失败:', error);\n        throw error;\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 2. 确保所有关联表存在\n    const relationTables = [\n      {\n    ];\n}",

        "contents": "export class BrainstormSessionModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 迁移：添加 project_id 字段\n   */\n  private async migrateAddProjectId(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    try {\n      const dbType = this.db.getType();\n      \n      // 检查字段是否已存在\n      let columnExists = false;\n      if (dbType === 'sqlite') {\n        const tableInfo = await this.db.query('PRAGMA table_info(brainstorm_sessions)');\n        const columns = Array.isArray(tableInfo) ? tableInfo : [tableInfo];\n        columnExists = columns.some((col: any) =&gt; col.name === 'project_id');\n      } else {\n        const checkResult = await this.db.query(&#96;\n          SELECT EXISTS (\n            SELECT FROM information_schema.columns \n            WHERE table_schema = 'public' \n            AND table_name = 'brainstorm_sessions' \n            AND column_name = 'project_id'\n          )\n        &#96;);\n        columnExists = checkResult[0]?.exists === true;\n      }\n\n      if (!columnExists) {\n        if (dbType === 'sqlite') {\n          await this.db.query('ALTER TABLE brainstorm_sessions ADD COLUMN project_id INTEGER');\n        } else {\n          await this.db.query('ALTER TABLE brainstorm_sessions ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS project_id INTEGER');\n        }\n        \n        // 创建索引\n        await this.db.query('CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_brainstorm_sessions_project_id ON brainstorm_sessions(project_id)');\n        console.log('✅ 已添加 project_id 字段到 brainstorm_sessions 表');\n      }\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      // 忽略字段已存在的错误\n      if (!error.message?.includes('duplicate column') &amp;&amp; !error.message?.includes('already exists')) {\n        console.warn('添加 project_id 字段时出现警告:', error.message);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n\n  /**\n   * 创建会话\n   */\n  async create(data: CreateBrainstormSessionDTO): Promise&lt;BrainstormSessionDTO&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": ");\n\n-- 项目来源表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_sources (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    source_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_type IN ('file', 'url', 'text', 'tech_point', 'knowledge_point')),\n    source_content TEXT NOT NULL,\n    source_title TEXT,\n    source_description TEXT,\n    metadata TEXT, -- JSON格式\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 项目与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(project_id, tech_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 项目与知识点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_knowledge_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    knowledge_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (knowledge_point_id) REFERENCES knowledge_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(project_id, knowledge_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 项目与文件关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_files (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,",

        "contents": "async function fixProjectRelations() {\nconst relationTables = [\n&#96;\n      },\n      {\n        name: 'project_source_informations',\n        sql: &#96;\n          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_source_informations (\n            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n            project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n            source_information_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n            notes TEXT,\n            created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n            updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n            FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n            FOREIGN KEY (source_information_id) REFERENCES source_information(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n            UNIQUE(project_id, source_information_id)\n          )\n        &#96;\n      }\n    ];\n\n    for (const { name, sql } of relationTables) {\n      logger.info(&#96;检查并创建 ${name} 表...&#96;);\n      try {\n        await db.query(sql);\n        \n        // 创建索引\n        await db.query(&#96;\n          CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_${name}_project_id ON ${name}(project_id)\n        &#96;);\n        \n        logger.info(&#96;✓ ${name} 表已就绪&#96;);\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        logger.error(&#96;创建 ${name} 表失败:&#96;, error);\n        throw error;\n      }\n    }\n\n    logger.info('\\n✓ 所有关联关系已修复完成！');\n\n  } catch (error) {\n    logger.error('修复过程出错:', error);\n    throw error;\n  } finally {\n    await db.close();\n  }\n}\n\nasync function checkColumnExists(db: any, tableName: string, columnName: string): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n  \n}",

        "contents": "-- 4. 在 project_source_informations 表中建立关联\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 确保 project_source_informations 表存在\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_source_informations (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    source_information_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (source_information_id) REFERENCES source_information(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(project_id, source_information_id)\n);\n\n-- 为已有 project_id 的来源信息创建关联记录\nINSERT INTO project_source_informations (project_id, source_information_id, created_at)\nSELECT \n    project_id,\n    id,\n    created_at\nFROM source_information\nWHERE project_id IS NOT NULL\n  AND NOT EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 \n    FROM project_source_informations psi\n    WHERE psi.project_id = source_information.project_id\n      AND psi.source_information_id = source_information.id\n  );\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 5. 创建索引优化查询性能\n-- ==============================================\n\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_project_source_informations_project_id \nON project_source_informations(project_id);\n\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_project_source_informations_source_information_id \nON project_source_informations(source_information_id);\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 迁移完成\n-- ==============================================",

        "contents": "export class SourceInformationModel {\nasync findByPageType(pageType: string): Promise&lt;SourceInformation[]&gt; {\n\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据项目ID获取来源信息列表\n   * 支持三种方式：\n   * 1. 通过 project_id 字段查询（主要方式）\n   * 2. 通过关联表 project_source_informations 查询（补充方式）\n   * 3. 通过 page_type = 'project-{projectId}' 查询（兼容旧数据）\n   */\n  async findByProjectId(projectId: number): Promise&lt;SourceInformation[]&gt; {\n    const pageType = &#96;project-${projectId}&#96;;\n    const results: SourceInformation[] = [];\n    const seenIds = new Set&lt;number&gt;();\n    \n    try {\n      // 方式1: 通过 project_id 字段查询\n      try {\n        const sql1 = &#96;\n          SELECT * FROM source_information\n          WHERE project_id = ? AND status = 'active'\n          ORDER BY created_at DESC\n        &#96;;\n        const result1 = await this.db.query(sql1, [projectId]);\n        const rows1 = Array.isArray(result1) ? result1 : [result1];\n        for (const row of rows1) {\n          const parsed = this.parseJsonFields(row) as SourceInformation;\n          if (parsed.id &amp;&amp; !seenIds.has(parsed.id)) {\n            results.push(parsed);\n            seenIds.add(parsed.id);\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        // 如果 project_id 字段不存在，忽略错误\n        if (!error?.message?.includes('no such column: project_id') &amp;&amp; \n            !error?.message?.includes('column \"project_id\" does not exist')) {\n          console.warn('查询 project_id 字段失败:', error?.message);\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // 方式2: 通过关联表查询\n      try\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class SourceInformationService {\nasync initializeTable(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\nconst statements = [\n&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_project_source_informations_project_id ON project_source_informations(project_id)&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_project_source_informations_source_information_id ON project_source_informations(source_information_id)&#96;\n      ];\n      \n      for (const sql of statements) {\n        try {\n          await db.query(sql);\n        } catch (error: any) {\n          // 忽略表或索引已存在的错误\n          if (error?.message?.includes('already exists') || \n              error?.message?.includes('duplicate') ||\n              error?.code === 'SQLITE_CONSTRAINT') {\n            console.warn('表或索引可能已存在，继续执行:', error.message);\n            continue;\n          }\n          throw error;\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // 检查并添加 project_id 字段（如果表已存在但缺少该字段）\n      try {\n        const tableInfo = await db.query(&#96;PRAGMA table_info(source_information)&#96;);\n        const columns = Array.isArray(tableInfo) ? tableInfo : [tableInfo];\n        const hasProjectId = columns.some((col: any) =&gt; col.name === 'project_id');\n        \n        if (!hasProjectId) {\n          console.log('检测到 source_information 表缺少 project_id 字段，正在添加...');\n          await db.query(&#96;ALTER TABLE source_information ADD COLUMN project_id INTEGER&#96;);\n          await db.query(&#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_project_id ON source_information(project_id)&#96;);\n          console.log('成功添加 project_id 字段');\n        }\n      } catch (migrationError: any) {\n        // 如果字段已存在或其他错误，记录但不中断\n        if (!migrationError?.message?.includes('duplicate column')) {\n          console.warn('迁移 project_id 字段时出现警告:', migrationError?.message);\n        }\n      }\n      \n      console.log('来源信息表初始化成功');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('初始化来源信息表失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 创建来源信息\n   */\n  async createSourceInformation(data: CreateSourceInformationDTO): Promise&lt;SourceInformation&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class SourceInformationService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 创建来源信息\n   */\n  async createSourceInformation(data: CreateSourceInformationDTO): Promise&lt;SourceInformation&gt; {\n    // 检查source_id是否已存在（只检查活跃状态的记录）\n    const existing = await this.model.findBySourceId(data.source_id);\n    if (existing &amp;&amp; existing.status === 'active') {\n      // 如果已存在且是活跃状态，更新而不是创建\n      const updated = await this.model.updateBySourceId(data.source_id, data);\n      if (!updated) {\n        throw new Error('更新来源信息失败');\n      }\n      \n      // 如果提供了 project_id，确保关联存在\n      if (data.project_id &amp;&amp; updated.id) {\n        await this.model.createProjectAssociation(data.project_id, updated.id);\n      }\n      \n      return updated;\n    }\n    \n    // 如果记录不存在或者是已删除状态，创建新记录\n    // 如果已删除的记录存在，先物理删除它，然后创建新记录\n    if (existing &amp;&amp; existing.status === 'deleted') {\n      // 物理删除已删除的记录，避免重复\n      await this.model.hardDelete(existing.id);\n    }\n    \n    const created = await this.model.create(data);\n    \n    // 如果提供了 project_id，创建项目关联\n    if (data.project_id &amp;&amp; created.id) {\n      await this.model.createProjectAssociation(data.project_id, created.id);\n    }\n    \n    return created;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID获取来源信息\n   */\n  async getSourceInformationById(id: number): Promise&lt;SourceInformation | null&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "async function verifyProjectRelations() {\n\n    results.forEach(result =&gt; {\n      logger.info(&#96;\\n表: ${result.table}&#96;);\n      logger.info(&#96;  存在: ${result.exists ? '✓' : '✗'}&#96;);\n      logger.info(&#96;  有 project_id: ${result.hasProjectId ? '✓' : '✗'}&#96;);\n      logger.info(&#96;  记录数: ${result.sampleCount}&#96;);\n      logger.info(&#96;  关联记录数: ${result.relationCount}&#96;);\n      if (result.issues.length &gt; 0) {\n        logger.warn(&#96;  问题:&#96;);\n        result.issues.forEach(issue =&gt; logger.warn(&#96;    - ${issue}&#96;));\n      }\n    });\n\n    // 检查是否有问题\n    const hasIssues = results.some(r =&gt; r.issues.length &gt; 0 || !r.exists);\n    if (hasIssues) {\n      logger.warn('\\n⚠️  发现以下问题需要修复:');\n      results.forEach(result =&gt; {\n        if (result.issues.length &gt; 0 || !result.exists) {\n          logger.warn(&#96;  - ${result.table}: ${result.issues.join(', ')}&#96;);\n        }\n      });\n    } else {\n      logger.info('\\n✓ 所有关联关系验证通过！');\n    }\n\n  } catch (error) {\n    logger.error('验证过程出错:', error);\n    throw error;\n  } finally {\n    await db.close();\n  }\n}\n\nasync function tableExists(db: any, tableName: string): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n  try\n}",

        "contents": ");\n\n-- 实时统计汇总表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workflow_stats_summary (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    stat_date DATE NOT NULL, -- 统计日期\n    node_id TEXT NOT NULL, -- 节点ID\n    \n    -- 使用统计\n    total_usage_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    unique_users INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    avg_response_time REAL DEFAULT 0,\n    success_rate REAL DEFAULT 0,\n    \n    -- 内容统计\n    total_characters INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    avg_characters INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    avg_content_quality REAL DEFAULT 0,\n    \n    -- 用户交互统计\n    total_likes INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    total_dislikes INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    total_regenerations INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    total_adoptions INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    total_edits INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    \n    -- 采纳率统计\n    direct_adoption_rate REAL DEFAULT 0,\n    edit_adoption_rate REAL DEFAULT 0,\n    abandonment_rate REAL DEFAULT 0,\n    \n    -- 工作流统计\n    workflow_completion_rate REAL DEFAULT 0,\n    avg_session_duration REAL DEFAULT 0,\n    common_exit_points TEXT, -- JSON格式\n    \n    -- 时间戳\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    \n    UNIQUE(stat_date, node_id)\n);\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 项目管理相关表\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 项目表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS projects (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    description TEXT,\n    cover_image TEXT,\n    icon TEXT,\n    type TEXT DEFAULT 'normal' CHECK (type IN ('normal', 'featured')),\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n    created_by TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    last_opened_at DATETIME\n);\n\n-- 项目来源表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_sources (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,",

已优化保存逻辑，主要改进：

## 修复内容

### 1. **修复 ID 处理**
- 优先使用 `id`，若无则使用 `source_id` 通过 `/source-id/:sourceId` 端点更新
- 兼容两种更新方式

### 2. **优化 project_id 处理**
- 使用 `projectId !== undefined` 判断是否更新 `project_id`
- 正确处理 `null` 值（取消关联项目）
- 避免 `0` 或 `false` 被误判为 `null`

### 3. **改进错误处理**
- 显示更详细的错误信息
- 从响应中提取具体错误消息
- 更好的错误日志记录

### 4. **数据构建优化**
- 只传递有值的字段
- 正确处理可选字段的 `null` 值

        "contents": "export class SourceInformationService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 创建来源信息\n   */\n  async createSourceInformation(data: CreateSourceInformationDTO): Promise&lt;SourceInformation&gt; {\n    // 检查source_id是否已存在（只检查活跃状态的记录）\n    const existing = await this.model.findBySourceId(data.source_id);\n    if (existing &amp;&amp; existing.status === 'active') {\n      // 如果已存在且是活跃状态，更新而不是创建\n      const updated = await this.model.updateBySourceId(data.source_id, data);\n      if (!updated) {\n        throw new Error('更新来源信息失败');\n      }\n      \n      // 如果提供了 project_id，确保关联存在\n      if (data.project_id &amp;&amp; updated.id) {\n        await this.model.createProjectAssociation(data.project_id, updated.id);\n      }\n      \n      return updated;\n    }\n    \n    // 如果记录不存在或者是已删除状态，创建新记录\n    // 如果已删除的记录存在，先物理删除它，然后创建新记录\n    if (existing &amp;&amp; existing.status === 'deleted') {\n      // 物理删除已删除的记录，避免重复\n      await this.model.hardDelete(existing.id);\n    }\n    \n    const created = await this.model.create(data);\n    \n    // 如果提供了 project_id，创建项目关联\n    if (data.project_id &amp;&amp; created.id) {\n      await this.model.createProjectAssociation(data.project_id, created.id);\n    }\n    \n    return created;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID获取来源信息\n   */\n  async getSourceInformationById(id: number): Promise&lt;SourceInformation | null&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "// 更新来源信息\nrouter.put('/:id', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const id = parseInt(req.params.id);\n    const data: UpdateSourceInformationDTO = req.body;\n    \n    if (isNaN(id)) {\n      return res.status(400).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '无效的来源信息ID'\n      });\n    }\n\n    const sourceInformation = await sourceInformationService.updateSourceInformation(id, data);\n    \n    if (!sourceInformation) {\n      return res.status(404).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '来源信息不存在'\n      });\n    }\n    \n    res.json({\n      success: true,\n      data: sourceInformation,\n      message: '来源信息更新成功'\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('更新来源信息失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      message: '更新来源信息失败',\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// 根据source_id更新来源信息\nrouter.put",

        "contents": "export class SourceInformationModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 创建来源信息\n   */\n  async create(data: CreateSourceInformationDTO): Promise&lt;SourceInformation&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      INSERT INTO source_information (\n        source_id, title, type, url, description, page_type, \n        conversation_id, project_id, metadata, status, created_by\n      )\n      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const values = [\n      data.source_id,\n      data.title,\n      data.type,\n      data.url || null,\n      data.description || null,\n      data.page_type || null,\n      data.conversation_id || null,\n      data.project_id || null,\n      data.metadata ? JSON.stringify(data.metadata) : null,\n      data.status || 'active',\n      data.created_by || null\n    ];\n\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    const id = result.lastID || result.insertId;\n    \n    const sourceInfo = await this.findById(id);\n    if (!sourceInfo) {\n      throw new Error('Failed to create source information');\n    }\n    \n    return sourceInfo;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID获取来源信息\n   */\n  async findById(id: number): Promise&lt;SourceInformation | null&gt; {\n    const sql = 'SELECT * FROM source_information WHERE id = ?';\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class ProjectModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 添加来源信息到项目\n   * 注意：SourceInformation 功能已移除，此方法返回 false\n   */\n  async addSourceInformation(projectId: number, sourceInformationId: number, notes?: string): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n    try {\n      const sql = &#96;\n        INSERT OR IGNORE INTO project_source_informations (project_id, source_information_id, notes)\n        VALUES (?, ?, ?)\n      &#96;;\n      const result = await this.db.query(sql, [projectId, sourceInformationId, notes || null]);\n      return (result as any).changes &gt; 0 || (result as any).lastID !== undefined;\n    } catch (error) {\n      // 如果表不存在或操作失败，返回 false\n      console.warn('addSourceInformation: SourceInformation table may not exist, returning false', error);\n      return false;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 从项目移除来源信息\n   * 注意：SourceInformation 功能已移除，此方法返回 false\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "// 根据source_id更新来源信息\nrouter.put('/source-id/:sourceId', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const { sourceId } = req.params;\n    const data: UpdateSourceInformationDTO = req.body;\n\n    const sourceInformation = await sourceInformationService.updateSourceInformationBySourceId(sourceId, data);\n    \n    if (!sourceInformation) {\n      return res.status(404).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '来源信息不存在'\n      });\n    }\n    \n    res.json({\n      success: true,\n      data: sourceInformation,\n      message: '来源信息更新成功'\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('更新来源信息失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      message: '更新来源信息失败',\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// 删除来源信息\nrouter.delete('/:id',",

        "contents": "export class SourceInformationService {\nasync initializeTable(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\nconst statements = [\n&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_project_source_informations_project_id ON project_source_informations(project_id)&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_project_source_informations_source_information_id ON project_source_informations(source_information_id)&#96;\n      ];\n      \n      for (const sql of statements) {\n        try {\n          await db.query(sql);\n        } catch (error: any) {\n          // 忽略表或索引已存在的错误\n          if (error?.message?.includes('already exists') || \n              error?.message?.includes('duplicate') ||\n              error?.code === 'SQLITE_CONSTRAINT') {\n            console.warn('表或索引可能已存在，继续执行:', error.message);\n            continue;\n          }\n          throw error;\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // 检查并添加 project_id 字段（如果表已存在但缺少该字段）\n      try {\n        const tableInfo = await db.query(&#96;PRAGMA table_info(source_information)&#96;);\n        const columns = Array.isArray(tableInfo) ? tableInfo : [tableInfo];\n        const hasProjectId = columns.some((col: any) =&gt; col.name === 'project_id');\n        \n        if (!hasProjectId) {\n          console.log('检测到 source_information 表缺少 project_id 字段，正在添加...');\n          await db.query(&#96;ALTER TABLE source_information ADD COLUMN project_id INTEGER&#96;);\n          await db.query(&#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_project_id ON source_information(project_id)&#96;);\n          console.log('成功添加 project_id 字段');\n        }\n      } catch (migrationError: any) {\n        // 如果字段已存在或其他错误，记录但不中断\n        if (!migrationError?.message?.includes('duplicate column')) {\n          console.warn('迁移 project_id 字段时出现警告:', migrationError?.message);\n        }\n      }\n      \n      console.log('来源信息表初始化成功');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('初始化来源信息表失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 创建来源信息\n   */\n  async createSourceInformation(data: CreateSourceInformationDTO): Promise&lt;SourceInformation&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "-- 来源信息表\n-- 用于存储通过 SourceSidebar 添加的信息（包括文本来源和外部来源）\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS source_information (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    source_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COMMENT '来源唯一标识（前端生成的ID）',\n    title TEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '来源标题',\n    type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('knowledge_base', 'external')) COMMENT '来源类型：knowledge_base=知识库，external=外部来源',\n    url TEXT COMMENT '外部来源URL（仅external类型）',\n    description TEXT COMMENT '来源描述/内容',\n    page_type TEXT COMMENT '页面类型：tech-package, press-release, tech-strategy, tech-article',\n    conversation_id TEXT COMMENT '关联的对话ID',\n    metadata TEXT COMMENT '元数据（JSON格式）',\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')) COMMENT '状态',\n    created_by TEXT COMMENT '创建人',\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 创建索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_source_id ON source_information(source_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_type ON source_information(type);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_page_type ON source_information(page_type);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_conversation_id ON source_information(conversation_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_status ON source_information(status);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_created_at ON source_information(created_at);",

        "contents": "export class SourceInformationModel {\nasync findByProjectId(projectId: number): Promise&lt;SourceInformation[]&gt; {\n\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // 方式2: 通过关联表查询\n      try {\n        const sql2 = &#96;\n          SELECT si.* FROM source_information si\n          INNER JOIN project_source_informations psi ON si.id = psi.source_information_id\n          WHERE psi.project_id = ? AND si.status = 'active'\n          ORDER BY si.created_at DESC\n        &#96;;\n        const result2 = await this.db.query(sql2, [projectId]);\n        const rows2 = Array.isArray(result2) ? result2 : [result2];\n        for (const row of rows2) {\n          const parsed = this.parseJsonFields(row) as SourceInformation;\n          if (parsed.id &amp;&amp; !seenIds.has(parsed.id)) {\n            results.push(parsed);\n            seenIds.add(parsed.id);\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        // 如果关联表不存在，忽略错误\n        if (!error?.message?.includes('no such table: project_source_informations') &amp;&amp;\n            !error?.message?.includes('relation \"project_source_informations\" does not exist')) {\n          console.warn('查询关联表失败:', error?.message);\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // 方式3: 通过 page_type 查询（兼容旧数据）\n      try {\n        const sql3 = &#96;\n          SELECT * FROM source_information\n          WHERE page_type = ? AND status = 'active'\n          ORDER BY created_at DESC\n        &#96;;\n        const result3 = await this.db.query(sql3, [pageType]);\n        const rows3 = Array.isArray(result3) ? result3 : [result3];\n        for (const row of rows3) {\n          const parsed = this.parseJsonFields(row) as SourceInformation;\n          if (parsed.id &amp;&amp; !seenIds.has(parsed.id)) {\n            results.push(parsed);\n            seenIds.add(parsed.id);\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        console.warn('查询 page_type 失败:', error?.message);\n      }\n      \n      // 按创建时间排序\n      results.sort\n\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "class SQLiteManager {\n\n\n  async query(sql: string, params: any[] = []): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    if (!this.db) {\n      throw new Error('数据库未连接');\n    }\n\n    // 注释掉调试日志以减少输出\n    // console.log('SQLiteManager.query - SQL:', sql);\n    // console.log('SQLiteManager.query - Params:', params);\n\n    return new Promise((resolve, reject) =&gt; {\n      if (sql.trim().toLowerCase().startsWith('select')) {\n        this.db!.all(sql, params, (err, rows) =&gt; {\n          if (err) {\n            console.error('SQLiteManager.query - Error:', err);\n            reject(err);\n          } else {\n            // console.log('SQLiteManager.query - Rows returned:', rows.length);\n            // console.log('SQLiteManager.query - First few rows:', rows.slice(0, 3));\n            resolve(rows);\n          }\n        });\n      } else {\n        this.db!.run(sql, params, function(err) {\n          if (err) {\n            console.error('SQLiteManager.query - Error:', err);\n            reject(err);\n          } else {\n            // console.log('SQLiteManager.query - Changes:', this.changes, 'LastID:', this.lastID);\n            resolve({ \n              lastID: this.lastID, \n              changes: this.changes \n            });\n          }\n        });\n      }\n    });\n  }\n\n  async close(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    if (this.db)\n  }\n}",
