      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./backend/src/scripts/migration-source-to-project.sql",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 54
          }
        },
        "contents": "-- 来源信息项目关联迁移脚本\n-- 创建日期: 2025-01-XX\n-- 说明: 将来源信息从 page_type 维度迁移到项目维度\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 1. 添加 project_id 字段到 source_information 表\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 检查并添加 project_id 字段（SQLite 不支持 IF NOT EXISTS，需要先检查）\n-- 如果字段已存在，此操作会失败，需要在应用层处理\n\n-- 添加 project_id 字段\nALTER TABLE source_information ADD COLUMN project_id INTEGER;\n\n-- 创建索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_project_id ON source_information(project_id);\n\n-- 添加外键约束（SQLite 3.37.0+ 支持，旧版本可能需要重建表）\n-- 注意：SQLite 的 ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN 不支持直接添加外键\n-- 如果需要外键约束，需要重建表，这里先添加字段，外键约束在应用层处理\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 2. 从 page_type 中提取项目 ID 并更新 project_id\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 更新 project_id：从 page_type 中提取项目ID\n-- 格式: tech-package-project-123, tech-strategy-project-456 等\nUPDATE source_information\nSET project_id = CAST(\n  SUBSTR(\n    page_type,\n    INSTR(page_type, 'project-') + 8\n  ) AS INTEGER\n)\nWHERE page_type LIKE '%-project-%'\n  AND project_id IS NULL;\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 3. 清理 page_type 字段，保留标准格式\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 将 tech-package-project-123 格式转换为 tech-package\nUPDATE source_information\nSET page_type = SUBSTR(page_type, 1, INSTR(page_type, '-project-') - 1)\nWHERE page_type LIKE '%-project-%'\n  AND INSTR(page_type, '-project-') &gt; 0;\n\n-- 将 tech-strategy-project-123 格式转换为 tech-strategy\n-- 注意：上面的 UPDATE 已经处理了所有 -project- 的情况\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 4. 在 project_source_informations 表中建立关联\n-- ==============================================",

        "contents": "export class ProjectModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 从项目移除来源信息\n   * 注意：SourceInformation 功能已移除，此方法返回 false\n   */\n  async removeSourceInformation(projectId: number, sourceInformationId: number): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n    try {\n      const sql = 'DELETE FROM project_source_informations WHERE project_id = ?         "contents": "export class SourceInformationModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取所有来源信息\n   */\n  async findAll(options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&lt;PaginatedResult&lt;SourceInformation&gt;&gt; {\n    let sql = 'SELECT * FROM source_information';\n    const values: any[] = [];\n    const conditions: string[] = [];\n\n    // 添加WHERE条件\n    if (options.where) {\n      Object.entries(options.where).forEach(([key, value]) =&gt; {\n        conditions.push(&#96;${key} = ?&#96;);\n        values.push(value);\n      });\n    }\n\n    if (conditions.length &gt; 0) {\n      sql += ' WHERE ' + conditions.join(' AND ');\n    }\n\n    // 添加排序\n    if (options.orderBy) {\n      sql += &#96; ORDER BY ${options.orderBy} ${options.orderDirection || 'ASC'}&#96;;\n    } else {\n      sql += ' ORDER BY created_at DESC';\n    }\n\n    // 获取总数\n    const countSql = sql.replace('SELECT *', 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count');\n    const countResult = await this.db.query(countSql, values);\n    const total = Array.isArray(countResult) ? countResult[0].count : countResult.count;\n\n    // 添加分页\n    if (options.limit) {\n      sql += &#96; LIMIT ${options.limit}&#96;;\n      if (options.offset) {\n        sql += &#96; OFFSET ${options.offset}&#96;;\n      }\n    }\n\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    const rows = Array.isArray(result) ? result : [result];\n    const data = rows.map((row: any) =&gt; this.parseJsonFields(row)) as SourceInformation[];\n    \n    const pageSize = options.limit || total;\n    const page = options.offset ? Math.floor(options.offset / pageSize) + 1 : 1;\n    \n    return {\n      data,\n      total,\n      page,\n      pageSize,\n      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize)\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据对话ID获取来源信息列表\n   */\n  async findByConversationId(conversationId: string): Promise&lt;SourceInformation[]&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class SourceInformationModel {\nasync findByPageType(pageType: string): Promise&lt;SourceInformation[]&gt; {\n\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据项目ID获取来源信息列表\n   * 支持三种方式：\n   * 1. 通过 project_id 字段查询（主要方式）\n   * 2. 通过关联表 project_source_informations 查询（补充方式）\n   * 3. 通过 page_type = 'project-{projectId}' 查询（兼容旧数据）\n   */\n  async findByProjectId(projectId: number): Promise&lt;SourceInformation[]&gt; {\n    const pageType = &#96;project-${projectId}&#96;;\n    const results: SourceInformation[] = [];\n    const seenIds = new Set&lt;number&gt;();\n    \n    try {\n      // 方式1: 通过 project_id 字段查询\n      try {\n        const sql1 = &#96;\n          SELECT * FROM source_information\n          WHERE project_id = ? AND status = 'active'\n          ORDER BY created_at DESC\n        &#96;;\n        const result1 = await this.db.query(sql1, [projectId]);\n        const rows1 = Array.isArray(result1) ? result1 : [result1];\n        for (const row of rows1) {\n          const parsed = this.parseJsonFields(row) as SourceInformation;\n          if (parsed.id &amp;&amp; !seenIds.has(parsed.id)) {\n            results.push(parsed);\n            seenIds.add(parsed.id);\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        // 如果 project_id 字段不存在，忽略错误\n        if (!error?.message?.includes('no such column: project_id') &amp;&amp; \n            !error?.message?.includes('column \"project_id\" does not exist')) {\n          console.warn('查询 project_id 字段失败:', error?.message);\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // 方式2: 通过关联表查询\n      try\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class ProjectModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 更新项目\n   */\n  async update(id: number, data: UpdateProjectDTO): Promise&lt;Project | null&gt; {\n    const fields: string[] = [];\n    const values: any[] = [];\n\n    Object.entries(data).forEach(([key, value]) =&gt; {\n      if (value !== undefined) {\n        fields.push(&#96;${key} = ?&#96;);\n        values.push(value);\n      }\n    });\n\n    if (fields.length === 0) {\n      return this.findById(id);\n    }\n\n    values.push(id);\n    \n    const sql = &#96;\n      UPDATE projects \n      SET ${fields.join(', ')}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n      WHERE id = ?\n    &#96;;\n\n    await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    return this.findById(id);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 更新最后打开时间\n   */\n  async updateLastOpenedAt(id: number): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      UPDATE projects \n      SET last_opened_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n      WHERE id = ?\n    &#96;;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class ProjectModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取所有项目\n   */\n  async findAll(options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&lt;PaginatedResult&lt;Project&gt;&gt; {\n    let sql = 'SELECT * FROM projects';\n    const values: any[] = [];\n    const conditions: string[] = [];\n\n    // 添加WHERE条件\n    if (options.where) {\n      Object.entries(options.where).forEach(([key, value]) =&gt; {\n        if (value === null) {\n          conditions.push(&#96;${key} IS NULL&#96;);\n        } else {\n          conditions.push(&#96;${key} = ?&#96;);\n          values.push(value);\n        }\n      });\n    }\n\n    if (conditions.length &gt; 0) {\n      sql += ' WHERE ' + conditions.join(' AND ');\n    }\n\n    // 添加排序\n    if (options.orderBy) {\n      sql += &#96; ORDER BY ${options.orderBy} ${options.orderDirection || 'ASC'}&#96;;\n    } else {\n      sql += ' ORDER BY created_at DESC';\n    }\n\n    // 获取总数\n    const countSql = sql.replace('SELECT *', 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count');\n    const countResult = await this.db.query(countSql, values);\n    const total = countResult[0].count;\n\n    // 添加分页\n    if (options.limit) {\n      sql += &#96; LIMIT ${options.limit}&#96;;\n      if (options.offset) {\n        sql += &#96; OFFSET ${options.offset}&#96;;\n      }\n    }\n\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    const data = result.map((row: any) =&gt; this.parseRow(row)) as Project[];\n    \n    const pageSize = options.limit || total;\n    const page = options.offset ? Math.floor(options.offset / pageSize) + 1 : 1;\n    \n    return {\n      data,\n      total,\n      page,\n      pageSize,\n      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize)\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取精选项目\n   */\n  async findFeatured(limit: number = 10): Promise&lt;Project[]&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      SELECT * FROM projects \n      WHERE type = ? AND status = ?\n      ORDER BY created_at DESC\n      LIMIT ?\n    &#96;;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class ProjectController {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 更新项目\n   */\n  async update(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try {\n      const id = parseInt(req.params.id);\n      if (isNaN(id)) {\n        return res.status(400).json({\n          success: false,\n          message: '无效的项目ID'\n        });\n      }\n\n      const data: UpdateProjectDTO = req.body;\n      const project = await projectModel.update(id, data);\n      \n      if (!project) {\n        return res.status(404).json({\n          success: false,\n          message: '项目不存在'\n        });\n      }\n\n      res.json({\n        success: true,\n        data: project,\n        message: '项目更新成功'\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Update project error:', error);\n      res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '更新项目失败'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 更新最后打开时间\n   */\n  async updateLastOpenedAt(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try\n  }\n}",

AND status = 'active'\n          ORDER BY created_at DESC\n        &#96;;\n        const result1 = await this.db.query(sql1, [projectId]);\n        const rows1 = Array.isArray(result1) ? result1 : [result1];\n        for (const row of rows1) {\n          const parsed = this.parseJsonFields(row) as SourceInformation;\n          if (parsed.id &amp;&amp; !seenIds.has(parsed.id)) {\n            results.push(parsed);\n            seenIds.add(parsed.id);\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        // 如果 project_id 字段不存在，忽略错误\n        if (!error?.message?.includes('no such column: project_id') &amp;&amp; \n            !error?.message?.includes('column \"project_id\" does not exist')) {\n          console.warn('查询 project_id 字段失败:', error?.message);\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // 方式2: 通过关联表查询\n      try\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class CarModelModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID查找车型\n   */\n  async findById(id: number, includeBrand: boolean = true): Promise&lt;CarModel&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n    \n    let sql = 'SELECT * FROM car_models WHERE id = ?';\n    \n    if (includeBrand) {\n      sql = &#96;\n        SELECT \n          cm.*,\n          b.id as brand_id_ref,\n          b.name as brand_name,\n          b.name_en as brand_name_en\n        FROM car_models cm\n        LEFT JOIN brands b ON cm.brand_id = b.id\n        WHERE cm.id = ?\n      &#96;;\n    }\n    \n    try {\n      const result = await this.db.query(sql, [id]);\n      const carModels = Array.isArray(result) ? result : result.rows || [result];\n      \n      if (carModels.length === 0) {\n        throw new Error('车型不存在');\n      }\n      \n      const carModel = carModels[0] as any;\n      \n      if (includeBrand &amp;&amp; carModel.brand_name) {\n        return {\n          ...carModel,\n          brand: {\n            id: carModel.brand_id,\n            name: carModel.brand_name,\n            name_en: carModel.brand_name_en\n          }\n        } as CarModel;\n      }\n      \n      return carModel as CarModel;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('查找车型失败:', error);\n      throw new Error('查找车型失败');\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 查找所有车型\n   */\n  async findAll(options: FindAllCarModelsOptions = {}): Promise&lt;{ carModels: CarModel[]; total: number }&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

已改进错误处理，主要改动如下：

## 后端改进

### 1. **添加 project_id 验证**
- 更新前验证 `project_id` 是否存在
- 若项目不存在，返回 400 错误，提示具体项目ID

### 2. **改进错误处理**
- 识别常见数据库错误（外键约束、字段不存在、唯一性约束等）
- 返回更明确的错误消息
- 开发环境返回详细错误信息（stack trace、错误代码等）

### 3. **错误日志**
- 记录错误详情（message、stack、code、errno）
- 便于排查问题

## 前端改进

### 1. **增强错误显示**
- 显示后端返回的具体错误消息
- 开发环境显示详细错误信息
- 添加调试日志，便于排查

### 2. **数据日志**
- 保存前记录更新数据和 URL
- 便于定位问题

现在保存时：
- 如果项目ID不存在，会提示“项目ID X 不存在”
- 如果是外键约束错误，会提示“项目ID不存在或无效”
- 其他错误也会显示更详细的信息

请再次尝试保存。如果仍有错误，错误提示会更清晰，便于定位问题。

        "contents": "export class BrainstormSessionModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 初始化数据库表\n   */\n  async initializeTable(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    \n    // 读取 SQL 文件并执行\n    const fs = require('fs');\n    const path = require('path');\n    const sqlPath = path.join(__dirname, '../../scripts/create-brainstorm-tables.sql');\n    \n    try {\n      const sql = fs.readFileSync(sqlPath, 'utf-8');\n      // 按分号分割 SQL 语句\n      const statements = sql\n        .split(';')\n        .map((s: string) =&gt; s.trim())\n        .filter((s: string) =&gt; s.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; !s.startsWith('--'));\n      \n      for (const statement of statements) {\n        try {\n          await this.db.query(statement);\n        } catch (error: any) {\n          // 忽略\"表已存在\"等错误\n          if (!error.message?.includes('already exists') &amp;&amp; !error.message?.includes('duplicate')) {\n            console.warn('执行 SQL 语句时出现警告:', error.message);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      // 如果文件不存在，使用内联 SQL\n      if (error.code === 'ENOENT') {\n        await this.initializeTableInline();\n      } else {\n        throw error;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 内联初始化表（当 SQL 文件不存在时使用）\n   */\n  private async initializeTableInline(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    const createTablesSQL = &#96;\n      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brainstorm_sessions (\n        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n        title TEXT NOT NULL,\n        topic TEXT NOT NULL,\n        description TEXT,\n        creator_id TEXT,\n        project_id INTEGER,\n        status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'active', 'completed', 'stopped')),\n        config TEXT,\n        summary TEXT,\n        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n        updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n        completed_at DATETIME\n      );\n\n      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brainstorm_participants (\n        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n        session_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n        ai_role_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n        display_name TEXT,\n        role_type TEXT,\n        sort_order INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n        FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES brainstorm_sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n      );\n\n      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brainstorm_messages (\n        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n        session_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n        participant_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n        round_number INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n        content TEXT NOT NULL,\n        reply_to_id TEXT,\n        metadata TEXT,\n        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n        FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES brainstorm_sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n        FOREIGN KEY (participant_id) REFERENCES brainstorm_participants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n        FOREIGN KEY (reply_to_id) REFERENCES brainstorm_messages(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\n      );\n    &#96;;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class ExecutionTraceModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 初始化表\n   */\n  async initializeTable(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n\n    await this.db.query(&#96;\n      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS execution_traces (\n        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n        execution_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n        agent_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n        step_name TEXT NOT NULL,\n        step_type TEXT NOT NULL,\n        input TEXT,\n        output TEXT,\n        duration INTEGER,\n        status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('success', 'failed', 'skipped')),\n        error TEXT,\n        metadata TEXT,\n        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n      )\n    &#96;);\n\n    // 创建索引\n    await this.db.query(&#96;\n      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_execution_traces_execution_id \n      ON execution_traces(execution_id)\n    &#96;);\n\n    await this.db.query(&#96;\n      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_execution_traces_agent_id \n      ON execution_traces(agent_id)\n    &#96;);\n\n    await this.db.query(&#96;\n      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_execution_traces_created_at \n      ON execution_traces(created_at)\n    &#96;);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 创建追踪记录\n   */\n  async create(data: CreateExecutionTraceDTO): Promise&lt;ExecutionTrace&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class ArticleTypeModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 初始化表结构\n   */\n  async initializeTable(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n    // 使用统一的SQL语句（SQLite和PostgreSQL都支持）\n    const createTableSQL = &#96;\n      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS article_types (\n        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n        code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n        name TEXT NOT NULL,\n        description TEXT,\n        enabled INTEGER DEFAULT 1,\n        sort_order INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n        updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n      );\n    &#96;;\n    \n    try {\n      await this.db.query(createTableSQL);\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      // 忽略\"表已存在\"等错误\n      if (!error.message?.includes('already exists') &amp;&amp; !error.message?.includes('duplicate')) {\n        console.warn('创建article_types表时出现警告:', error.message);\n      }\n    }\n    \n    // 创建索引\n    const indexes = [\n      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_article_types_code ON article_types(code);',\n      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_article_types_enabled ON article_types(enabled);',\n    ];\n    \n    for (const indexSQL of indexes) {\n      try {\n        await this.db.query(indexSQL);\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        // 忽略索引已存在的错误\n        if (!error.message?.includes('already exists') &amp;&amp; !error.message?.includes('duplicate')) {\n          console.warn('创建索引时出现警告:', error.message);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 初始化默认数据\n    await this.initializeDefaultData();\n    \n    // 初始化关联表\n    await this.initializeAssociationTable();\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 初始化默认数据\n   */\n  private async initializeDefaultData(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    const existing = await this.findAll();\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class AIRoleModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取所有AI角色\n   */\n  async getAll(): Promise&lt;AIRoleConfig[]&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n    await this.initializeTable();\n\n    const sql = 'SELECT * FROM ai_roles ORDER BY updated_at DESC';\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql);\n    const rows = Array.isArray(result) ? result : result.rows || [];\n\n    // 安全转换，跳过有问题的记录\n    const roles: AIRoleConfig[] = [];\n    for (const row of rows) {\n      try {\n        const role = this.toAIRoleConfig(row as AIRole);\n        roles.push(role);\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error(&#96;转换AI角色失败 (ID: ${(row as any).id}):&#96;, error);\n        // 继续处理其他记录，不中断整个流程\n      }\n    }\n\n    return roles;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取启用的AI角色\n   */\n  async getEnabled(): Promise&lt;AIRoleConfig[]&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class AgentWorkflowModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取所有工作流\n   */\n  async getAll(): Promise&lt;AgentWorkflow[]&gt; {\n    try {\n      await this.ensureConnection();\n\n      // 先检查表是否存在\n      const checkTableSql = &#96;\n        SELECT name FROM sqlite_master \n        WHERE type='table' AND name='agent_workflows'\n      &#96;;\n      const tableCheck = await this.db.query(checkTableSql);\n      const hasTable = Array.isArray(tableCheck) \n        ? tableCheck.length &gt; 0 \n        : (tableCheck as any)?.rows?.length &gt; 0 || !!tableCheck;\n\n      if (!hasTable) {\n        console.warn('⚠️  agent_workflows表不存在，返回空数组');\n        return [];\n      }\n\n      const sql = 'SELECT * FROM agent_workflows ORDER BY updated_at DESC';\n      const result = await this.db.query(sql);\n      const rows = Array.isArray(result) ? result : result.rows || [];\n\n      return rows.map((row: any) =&gt; ({\n        id: row.id,\n        name: row.name,\n        description: row.description,\n        version: row.version,\n        nodes: row.nodes,\n        edges: row.edges,\n        metadata: row.metadata,\n        published: row.published !== undefined ? row.published : 0,\n        created_at: row.created_at,\n        updated_at: row.updated_at,\n      }));\n    } catch (error) {\n      // 如果表不存在或查询失败，返回空数组而不是抛出错误\n      console.error('⚠️  获取工作流列表失败，返回空数组:', error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error));\n      return [];\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 更新工作流\n   */\n  async update(id: string, data: UpdateAgentWorkflowDTO): Promise&lt;AgentWorkflow&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class PublicKnowledgeModel {\n\n\n  // ==================== 文件相关方法 ====================\n\n  /**\n   * 创建文件记录\n   */\n  async createFile(data: CreateFileDTO): Promise&lt;PublicKnowledgeFile&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n    \n    const dbType = this.db.getType();\n    const sql = dbType === 'sqlite'\n      ? &#96;INSERT INTO public_knowledge_files (category_id, name, file_path, file_type, file_size, description, uploaded_by) \n         VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)&#96;\n      : &#96;INSERT INTO public_knowledge_files (category_id, name, file_path, file_type, file_size, description, uploaded_by) \n         VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7) RETURNING *&#96;;\n    \n    const values = [\n      data.category_id ?? null,\n      data.name,\n      data.file_path,\n      data.file_type,\n      data.file_size,\n      data.description ?? null,\n      data.uploaded_by ?? null\n    ];\n\n    if (dbType === 'sqlite') {\n      await this.db.query(sql, values);\n      const result = await this.db.query('SELECT * FROM public_knowledge_files WHERE id = last_insert_rowid()');\n      return result[0] as PublicKnowledgeFile;\n    } else {\n      const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n      return result[0] as PublicKnowledgeFile;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID获取文件\n   */\n  async getFileById(id: number): Promise&lt;PublicKnowledgeFile | null&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class PublicKnowledgeModel {\n\n\n  // ==================== 分类相关方法 ====================\n\n  /**\n   * 创建分类\n   */\n  async createCategory(data: CreateCategoryDTO): Promise&lt;PublicKnowledgeCategory&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n    \n    const dbType = this.db.getType();\n    const sql = dbType === 'sqlite'\n      ? &#96;INSERT INTO public_knowledge_categories (name, parent_id, sort_order) \n         VALUES (?, ?, ?)&#96;\n      : &#96;INSERT INTO public_knowledge_categories (name, parent_id, sort_order) \n         VALUES ($1, $2, $3) RETURNING *&#96;;\n    \n    const values = [\n      data.name,\n      data.parent_id ?? null,\n      data.sort_order ?? 0\n    ];\n\n    if (dbType === 'sqlite') {\n      await this.db.query(sql, values);\n      // SQLite 需要单独查询最后插入的ID\n      const result = await this.db.query('SELECT * FROM public_knowledge_categories WHERE id = last_insert_rowid()');\n      return result[0] as PublicKnowledgeCategory;\n    } else {\n      const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n      return result[0] as PublicKnowledgeCategory;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID获取分类\n   */\n  async getCategoryById(id: number): Promise&lt;PublicKnowledgeCategory | null&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        },
        "contents": "export class WorkflowExecutionModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 创建执行实例（支持Agent工作流和Dify工作流）\n   */\n  async create(data: CreateWorkflowExecutionDTO): Promise&lt;WorkflowExecution&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n\n    const id = data.id || &#96;exec_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(7)}&#96;;\n    const status = data.status || 'pending';\n    const executionType = data.execution_type;\n\n    const sql = &#96;\n      INSERT INTO workflow_executions (\n        id, execution_type, workflow_id, workflow_name, shared_context, node_results,\n        workflow_run_id, task_id, message_id, app_type,\n        status, error_message, inputs, outputs,\n        elapsed_time, total_tokens, total_steps, duration,\n        start_time, end_time, started_at, finished_at,\n        created_at, updated_at\n      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)\n    &#96;;\n\n    const params = [\n      id,\n      executionType,\n      // Agent工作流字段\n      data.workflow_id || null,\n      data.workflow_name || null,\n      data.shared_context ? JSON.stringify(data.shared_context) : null,\n      data.node_results ? JSON.stringify(data.node_results) : null,\n      // Dify工作流字段\n      data.workflow_run_id || null,\n      data.task_id || null,\n      data.message_id || null,\n      data.app_type || null,\n      // 通用字段\n      status,\n      data.error_message || null,\n      data.inputs ? JSON.stringify(data.inputs) : null,\n      data.outputs ? JSON.stringify(data.outputs) : null,\n      data.elapsed_time || null,\n      data.total_tokens || null,\n      data.total_steps || null,\n      data.duration || null,\n      // 时间戳\n      data.start_time || null,\n      data.end_time || null,\n      data.started_at || null,\n      data.finished_at || null,\n    ];\n\n    await this.db.query(sql, params);\n\n    return await this.getById(id) as WorkflowExecution;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID获取执行实例\n   */\n  async getById(id: string): Promise&lt;WorkflowExecution | null&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class AgentWorkflowModel {\nasync initializeTable(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n\n      }\n    }\n    \n    // 创建工作流执行表（统一结构，支持Agent工作流和Dify工作流）\n    // 注意：如果表已存在（通过迁移脚本创建），此CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS不会修改现有结构\n    const createExecutionTableSQL = &#96;\n      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workflow_executions (\n        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n        execution_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (execution_type IN ('agent_workflow', 'dify_workflow')),\n        \n        -- Agent工作流执行字段\n        workflow_id TEXT,\n        workflow_name TEXT,\n        shared_context TEXT DEFAULT '{}',\n        node_results TEXT DEFAULT '[]',\n        \n        -- Dify工作流执行字段\n        workflow_run_id TEXT UNIQUE,\n        task_id TEXT,\n        message_id TEXT,\n        app_type TEXT,\n        \n        -- 通用执行字段\n        status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',\n        error_message TEXT,\n        inputs TEXT,\n        outputs TEXT,\n        \n        -- 执行统计\n        elapsed_time REAL DEFAULT 0,\n        total_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n        total_steps INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n        duration INTEGER,\n        \n        -- 时间戳\n        start_time TIMESTAMP,\n        end_time TIMESTAMP,\n        started_at DATETIME,\n        finished_at DATETIME,\n        created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n        updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n        \n        FOREIGN KEY (workflow_id) REFERENCES agent_workflows(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\n        FOREIGN KEY (message_id) REFERENCES chat_messages(message_id) ON DELETE SET NULL\n      );\n    &#96;;\n    \n    try {\n      await this.db.query(createExecutionTableSQL);\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      if (!error.message?.includes('already exists') &amp;&amp; !error.message?.includes('duplicate')) {\n        console.warn('创建workflow_executions表时出现警告:', error.message);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 如果表已存在但缺少新字段，尝试添加（向后兼容）\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class BrandModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 创建品牌\n   */\n  async create(data: CreateBrandDTO): Promise&lt;Brand&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n    \n    const sql = &#96;\n      INSERT INTO brands (name, name_en, logo_url, country, founded_year, description, status)\n      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const params = [\n      data.name,\n      data.name_en || null,\n      data.logo_url || null,\n      data.country || null,\n      data.founded_year || null,\n      data.description || null,\n      data.status || BrandStatus.ACTIVE\n    ];\n\n    try {\n      const result = await this.db.query(sql, params);\n      const insertId = result.lastID || result.insertId;\n      \n      return await this.findById(insertId);\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error('创建品牌失败:', error);\n      if (error.message?.includes('UNIQUE constraint failed')) {\n        throw new Error('品牌名称已存在');\n      }\n      throw new Error('创建品牌失败');\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID查找品牌\n   */\n  async findById(id: number): Promise&lt;Brand&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class PublicKnowledgeModel {\nasync initializeTable(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\nconst createIndexesSQL = &#96;\n&#96;;\n\n      try {\n        await this.db.query(createCategoriesTableSQL);\n        await this.db.query(createFilesTableSQL);\n        const indexStatements = createIndexesSQL.split(';').filter(s =&gt; s.trim());\n        for (const statement of indexStatements) {\n          if (statement.trim()) {\n            await this.db.query(statement);\n          }\n        }\n        logger.info('公共知识库表初始化成功 (SQLite)');\n      } catch (error) {\n        logger.error('公共知识库表初始化失败:', error);\n        throw error;\n      }\n    } else {\n      // PostgreSQL 表结构\n      const createCategoriesTableSQL = &#96;\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public_knowledge_categories (\n          id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,\n          name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n          parent_id BIGINT,\n          sort_order INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n          created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n          updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n          FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES public_knowledge_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\n        );\n      &#96;;\n\n      const createFilesTableSQL = &#96;\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public_knowledge_files (\n          id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,\n          category_id BIGINT,\n          name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n          file_path TEXT NOT NULL,\n          file_type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,\n          file_size BIGINT NOT NULL,\n          description TEXT,\n          uploaded_by BIGINT,\n          created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n          updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n          FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES public_knowledge_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\n        );\n      &#96;;\n\n      const createIndexesSQL = &#96;\n        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_categories_parent_id ON public_knowledge_categories(parent_id);\n        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_categories_sort_order ON public_knowledge_categories(sort_order);\n        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_category_id ON public_knowledge_files(category_id);\n        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_created_at ON public_knowledge_files(created_at);\n      &#96;;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class CarSeriesModel {\nasync getTechPoints(carSeriesId: number): Promise&lt;any[]&gt; {\n\n      \n      if (testRows.length &gt; 0) {\n        console.log('硬编码查询成功，现在测试参数化查询');\n        \n        const sql = &#96;\n          SELECT \n            tp.id,\n            tp.name,\n            tp.description,\n            tp.tech_type,\n            tp.priority,\n            tp.status,\n            tp.tags,\n            tp.technical_details,\n            tp.benefits,\n            tp.applications,\n            tp.keywords,\n            tp.source_url,\n            tp.created_at,\n            tp.updated_at,\n            tpcm.application_status,\n            tpcm.implementation_date,\n            tpcm.notes as association_notes\n          FROM tech_points tp\n          INNER JOIN tech_point_car_models tpcm ON tp.id = tpcm.tech_point_id\n          INNER JOIN car_models cm ON tpcm.car_model_id = cm.id\n          INNER JOIN car_series cs ON cs.model_id = cm.id\n          WHERE cs.id = ?\n          ORDER BY tp.priority DESC, tp.name ASC\n        &#96;;\n        \n        console.log('执行参数化SQL查询:', sql);\n        console.log('查询参数:', [carSeriesId]);\n        \n        const rows = await this.db.query(sql, [carSeriesId]);\n        \n        console.log('参数化查询结果行数:', rows.length);\n        console.log('参数化查询结果:', rows);\n        \n        return rows.map((row: any) =&gt; ({\n          ...row,\n          tags: row.tags ? JSON.parse(row.tags) : [],\n          technical_details: row.technical_details ? JSON.parse(row.technical_details) : null,\n          benefits: row.benefits ? JSON.parse(row.benefits) : [],\n          applications: row.applications ? JSON.parse(row.applications) : [],\n          keywords: row.keywords ? JSON.parse(row.keywords) : []\n        }));\n      } else {\n        console.log('硬编码查询也失败了，返回空数组');\n        return [];\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('获取车系技术点失败:', error);\n      throw new Error('获取车系技术点失败');\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nexport const carSeriesModel = new CarSeriesModel();",

        "contents": "class PublicPageConfigService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 根据地址获取公开配置（包含角色列表）\n   */\n  async getPublicConfigByAddress(address: string): Promise&lt;PublicPageConfigPreview&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await api.get&lt;ApiResponse&lt;PublicPageConfigPreview&gt;&gt;(&#96;/public-by-address/${address}&#96;);\n      if (response.data.success &amp;&amp; response.data.data) {\n        return response.data.data;\n      }\n      const now = new Date();\n      return {\n        roles: [],\n        config: {\n          id: 'default',\n          name: '默认公开配置',\n          description: '后端未返回公开配置',\n          address,\n          displayMode: 'all',\n          accessToken: '',\n          isActive: false,\n          templateType: 'ai-chat',\n          createdAt: now,\n          updatedAt: now,\n        },\n      };\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      const code = error?.code;\n      const status = error?.response?.status;\n      const now = new Date();\n      if (status === 500 || status === 404 || code === 'ECONNREFUSED' || code === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\n        return {\n          roles: [],\n          config: {\n            id: 'default',\n            name: '默认公开配置',\n            description: '后端不可用或未配置公开数据',\n            address,\n            displayMode: 'all',\n            accessToken: '',\n            isActive: false,\n            templateType: 'ai-chat',\n            createdAt: now,\n            updatedAt: now,\n          },\n        };\n      }\n      console.error('获取公开配置失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 生成公开访问链接（通过token）\n   */\n  generatePublicUrl(token: string): string {\n    const baseUrl = window.location.origin;\n  }",

        "contents": "export const workflowAPI = {\n  // AI问答 - 支持自定义Dify配置\n  aiSearch: async (query: string, inputs: any = {}, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&lt;WorkflowResponse&gt; =&gt; {\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('aiSearch');\n\n    try {\n      const response = await apiClient.post&lt;{ message?: string }&gt;(\"/workflow/ai-search\", {\n        query,\n        inputs,\n        conversationId,\n      }, {\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\n      });\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\n    } catch (error) {\n      return handleApiError(\"AI search API\", error);\n    }\n  },\n\n  // 智能搜索\n  smartSearch: async (query: string, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&lt;WorkflowResponse&gt; =&gt; {\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('smartSearch');\n\n    try {\n      const requestData: any = { query };\n      if (conversationId) {\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\n      }\n\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\"/workflow/smart-search\", requestData, {\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\n      });\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\n    } catch (error) {\n      return handleApiError(\"Smart search API\", error);\n    }\n  },\n\n  // 技术包装\n  techPackage:\n,\n};",

        "contents": "class ExecutionTraceService {\n  /**\n   * 根据执行ID获取追踪记录\n   */\n  async getByExecutionId(executionId: string): Promise&lt;ExecutionTrace[]&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await axios.get&lt;ExecutionTraceListResponse&gt;(\n        &#96;${API_BASE_URL}/execution-traces?executionId=${executionId}&#96;\n      );\n      if (response.data.success) {\n        return response.data.data;\n      }\n      throw new Error(response.data.message || '获取执行追踪失败');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('获取执行追踪失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据Agent ID获取追踪记录\n   */\n  async getByAgentId(agentId: string): Promise&lt;ExecutionTrace[]&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await axios.get&lt;ExecutionTraceListResponse&gt;(\n        &#96;${API_BASE_URL}/execution-traces?agentId=${agentId}&#96;\n      );\n      if (response.data.success) {\n        return response.data.data;\n      }\n      throw new Error(response.data.message || '获取执行追踪失败');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('获取执行追踪失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取单个追踪记录详情\n   */\n  async getById(id: string): Promise&lt;ExecutionTrace&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await axios.get&lt;ExecutionTraceResponse&gt;(\n        &#96;${API_BASE_URL}/execution-traces/${id}&#96;\n      );\n      if (response.data.success) {\n        return response.data.data;\n      }\n      throw new Error(response.data.message || '获取执行追踪详情失败');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('获取执行追踪详情失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nexport default new ExecutionTraceService();",

        "contents": "-- 来源信息项目关联迁移脚本\n-- 创建日期: 2025-01-XX\n-- 说明: 将来源信息从 page_type 维度迁移到项目维度\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 1. 添加 project_id 字段到 source_information 表\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 检查并添加 project_id 字段（SQLite 不支持 IF NOT EXISTS，需要先检查）\n-- 如果字段已存在，此操作会失败，需要在应用层处理\n\n-- 添加 project_id 字段\nALTER TABLE source_information ADD COLUMN project_id INTEGER;\n\n-- 创建索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_project_id ON source_information(project_id);\n\n-- 添加外键约束（SQLite 3.37.0+ 支持，旧版本可能需要重建表）\n-- 注意：SQLite 的 ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN 不支持直接添加外键\n-- 如果需要外键约束，需要重建表，这里先添加字段，外键约束在应用层处理\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 2. 从 page_type 中提取项目 ID 并更新 project_id\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 更新 project_id：从 page_type 中提取项目ID\n-- 格式: tech-package-project-123, tech-strategy-project-456 等\nUPDATE source_information\nSET project_id = CAST(\n  SUBSTR(\n    page_type,\n    INSTR(page_type, 'project-') + 8\n  ) AS INTEGER\n)\nWHERE page_type LIKE '%-project-%'\n  AND project_id IS NULL;\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 3. 清理 page_type 字段，保留标准格式\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 将 tech-package-project-123 格式转换为 tech-package\nUPDATE source_information\nSET page_type = SUBSTR(page_type, 1, INSTR(page_type, '-project-') - 1)\nWHERE page_type LIKE '%-project-%'\n  AND INSTR(page_type, '-project-') &gt; 0;\n\n-- 将 tech-strategy-project-123 格式转换为 tech-strategy\n-- 注意：上面的 UPDATE 已经处理了所有 -project- 的情况\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 4. 在 project_source_informations 表中建立关联\n-- ==============================================",

        "contents": "export class SourceInformationService {\nasync initializeTable(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\nconst statements = [\n&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_project_source_informations_project_id ON project_source_informations(project_id)&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_project_source_informations_source_information_id ON project_source_informations(source_information_id)&#96;\n      ];\n      \n      for (const sql of statements) {\n        try {\n          await db.query(sql);\n        } catch (error: any) {\n          // 忽略表或索引已存在的错误\n          if (error?.message?.includes('already exists') || \n              error?.message?.includes('duplicate') ||\n              error?.code === 'SQLITE_CONSTRAINT') {\n            console.warn('表或索引可能已存在，继续执行:', error.message);\n            continue;\n          }\n          throw error;\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // 检查并添加 project_id 字段（如果表已存在但缺少该字段）\n      try {\n        const tableInfo = await db.query(&#96;PRAGMA table_info(source_information)&#96;);\n        const columns = Array.isArray(tableInfo) ? tableInfo : [tableInfo];\n        const hasProjectId = columns.some((col: any) =&gt; col.name === 'project_id');\n        \n        if (!hasProjectId) {\n          console.log('检测到 source_information 表缺少 project_id 字段，正在添加...');\n          await db.query(&#96;ALTER TABLE source_information ADD COLUMN project_id INTEGER&#96;);\n          await db.query(&#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_project_id ON source_information(project_id)&#96;);\n          console.log('成功添加 project_id 字段');\n        }\n      } catch (migrationError: any) {\n        // 如果字段已存在或其他错误，记录但不中断\n        if (!migrationError?.message?.includes('duplicate column')) {\n          console.warn('迁移 project_id 字段时出现警告:', migrationError?.message);\n        }\n      }\n      \n      console.log('来源信息表初始化成功');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('初始化来源信息表失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 创建来源信息\n   */\n  async createSourceInformation(data: CreateSourceInformationDTO): Promise&lt;SourceInformation&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "    UNIQUE(project_id, knowledge_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 项目与文件关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_files (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    file_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (file_id) REFERENCES files(file_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(project_id, file_id)\n);\n\n-- 项目与来源信息关联表（多对多，支持来源信息复用）\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_source_informations (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    source_information_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (source_information_id) REFERENCES source_information(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(project_id, source_information_id)\n);\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 3. 在生成内容表中添加 project_id 字段\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 技术包装材料表添加 project_id\n-- 注意：如果表已存在，需要先检查字段是否存在\n-- SQLite 不支持直接 ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS，需要手动检查\n-- 这里使用 ALTER TABLE，如果字段已存在会报错，需要在应用层处理\n\n-- 为 tech_packaging_materials 添加 project_id\n-- 先检查表是否存在 project_id 列（通过尝试添加，如果失败则忽略）\n-- 实际执行时，如果字段已存在，需要手动处理或使用应用层检查\n\nALTER TABLE tech_packaging_materials ADD COLUMN project_id INTEGER;\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tech_packaging_materials_project_id ON tech_packaging_materials(project_id);\n-- 添加外键约束（SQLite 3.37.0+ 支持，旧版本可能需要重建表）\n-- FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE SET NULL",

        "contents": "-- 4. 在 project_source_informations 表中建立关联\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 确保 project_source_informations 表存在\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_source_informations (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    source_information_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (source_information_id) REFERENCES source_information(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(project_id, source_information_id)\n);\n\n-- 为已有 project_id 的来源信息创建关联记录\nINSERT INTO project_source_informations (project_id, source_information_id, created_at)\nSELECT \n    project_id,\n    id,\n    created_at\nFROM source_information\nWHERE project_id IS NOT NULL\n  AND NOT EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 \n    FROM project_source_informations psi\n    WHERE psi.project_id = source_information.project_id\n      AND psi.source_information_id = source_information.id\n  );\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 5. 创建索引优化查询性能\n-- ==============================================\n\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_project_source_informations_project_id \nON project_source_informations(project_id);\n\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_project_source_informations_source_information_id \nON project_source_informations(source_information_id);\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 迁移完成\n-- ==============================================",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "-- 来源信息表\n-- 用于存储通过 SourceSidebar 添加的信息（包括文本来源和外部来源）\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS source_information (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    source_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COMMENT '来源唯一标识（前端生成的ID）',\n    title TEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '来源标题',\n    type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('knowledge_base', 'external')) COMMENT '来源类型：knowledge_base=知识库，external=外部来源',\n    url TEXT COMMENT '外部来源URL（仅external类型）',\n    description TEXT COMMENT '来源描述/内容',\n    page_type TEXT COMMENT '页面类型：tech-package, press-release, tech-strategy, tech-article',\n    conversation_id TEXT COMMENT '关联的对话ID',\n    metadata TEXT COMMENT '元数据（JSON格式）',\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')) COMMENT '状态',\n    created_by TEXT COMMENT '创建人',\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 创建索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_source_id ON source_information(source_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_type ON source_information(type);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_page_type ON source_information(page_type);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_conversation_id ON source_information(conversation_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_status ON source_information(status);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_created_at ON source_information(created_at);",

        "contents": "export class SourceInformationModel {\nasync findByPageType(pageType: string): Promise&lt;SourceInformation[]&gt; {\n\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据项目ID获取来源信息列表\n   * 支持三种方式：\n   * 1. 通过 project_id 字段查询（主要方式）\n   * 2. 通过关联表 project_source_informations 查询（补充方式）\n   * 3. 通过 page_type = 'project-{projectId}' 查询（兼容旧数据）\n   */\n  async findByProjectId(projectId: number): Promise&lt;SourceInformation[]&gt; {\n    const pageType = &#96;project-${projectId}&#96;;\n    const results: SourceInformation[] = [];\n    const seenIds = new Set&lt;number&gt;();\n    \n    try {\n      // 方式1: 通过 project_id 字段查询\n      try {\n        const sql1 = &#96;\n          SELECT * FROM source_information\n          WHERE project_id = ? AND status = 'active'\n          ORDER BY created_at DESC\n        &#96;;\n        const result1 = await this.db.query(sql1, [projectId]);\n        const rows1 = Array.isArray(result1) ? result1 : [result1];\n        for (const row of rows1) {\n          const parsed = this.parseJsonFields(row) as SourceInformation;\n          if (parsed.id &amp;&amp; !seenIds.has(parsed.id)) {\n            results.push(parsed);\n            seenIds.add(parsed.id);\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        // 如果 project_id 字段不存在，忽略错误\n        if (!error?.message?.includes('no such column: project_id') &amp;&amp; \n            !error?.message?.includes('column \"project_id\" does not exist')) {\n          console.warn('查询 project_id 字段失败:', error?.message);\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // 方式2: 通过关联表查询\n      try\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class BrainstormSessionModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 迁移：添加 project_id 字段\n   */\n  private async migrateAddProjectId(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    try {\n      const dbType = this.db.getType();\n      \n      // 检查字段是否已存在\n      let columnExists = false;\n      if (dbType === 'sqlite') {\n        const tableInfo = await this.db.query('PRAGMA table_info(brainstorm_sessions)');\n        const columns = Array.isArray(tableInfo) ? tableInfo : [tableInfo];\n        columnExists = columns.some((col: any) =&gt; col.name === 'project_id');\n      } else {\n        const checkResult = await this.db.query(&#96;\n          SELECT EXISTS (\n            SELECT FROM information_schema.columns \n            WHERE table_schema = 'public' \n            AND table_name = 'brainstorm_sessions' \n            AND column_name = 'project_id'\n          )\n        &#96;);\n        columnExists = checkResult[0]?.exists === true;\n      }\n\n      if (!columnExists) {\n        if (dbType === 'sqlite') {\n          await this.db.query('ALTER TABLE brainstorm_sessions ADD COLUMN project_id INTEGER');\n        } else {\n          await this.db.query('ALTER TABLE brainstorm_sessions ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS project_id INTEGER');\n        }\n        \n        // 创建索引\n        await this.db.query('CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_brainstorm_sessions_project_id ON brainstorm_sessions(project_id)');\n        console.log('✅ 已添加 project_id 字段到 brainstorm_sessions 表');\n      }\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      // 忽略字段已存在的错误\n      if (!error.message?.includes('duplicate column') &amp;&amp; !error.message?.includes('already exists')) {\n        console.warn('添加 project_id 字段时出现警告:', error.message);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n\n  /**\n   * 创建会话\n   */\n  async create(data: CreateBrainstormSessionDTO): Promise&lt;BrainstormSessionDTO&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "// 来源信息接口\nexport interface SourceInformation extends BaseEntity {\n  source_id: string;\n  title: string;\n  type: 'knowledge_base' | 'external';\n  url?: string;\n  description?: string;\n  page_type?: 'tech-package' | 'press-release' | 'tech-strategy' | 'tech-article';\n  conversation_id?: string;\n  project_id?: number;  // 关联的项目ID（可选）\n  metadata?: Record&lt;string, any&gt;;\n  status: 'active' | 'archived' | 'deleted';\n  created_by?: string;\n}\n\nexport type CreateSourceInformationDTO = Omit&lt;SourceInformation, 'id' | 'created_at' | 'updated_at'&gt;;",

        "contents": "-- 项目表\n-- 用于存储项目信息\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS projects (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    description TEXT,\n    cover_image TEXT,\n    icon TEXT,\n    type TEXT DEFAULT 'normal' CHECK (type IN ('normal', 'featured')),\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n    created_by TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    last_opened_at DATETIME\n);\n\n-- 项目来源表\n-- 用于关联项目与各种来源（文件、URL、文本、技术点等）\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_sources (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    source_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_type IN ('file', 'url', 'text', 'tech_point', 'knowledge_point')),\n    source_content TEXT NOT NULL,\n    source_title TEXT,\n    source_description TEXT,\n    metadata TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 创建索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_type ON projects(type);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_status ON projects(status);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_created_at ON projects(created_at);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_last_opened_at ON projects(last_opened_at);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_project_sources_project_id ON project_sources(project_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_project_sources_source_type ON project_sources(source_type);",

        "contents": "export class ProjectModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 添加来源信息到项目\n   * 注意：SourceInformation 功能已移除，此方法返回 false\n   */\n  async addSourceInformation(projectId: number, sourceInformationId: number, notes?: string): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n    try {\n      const sql = &#96;\n        INSERT OR IGNORE INTO project_source_informations (project_id, source_information_id, notes)\n        VALUES (?, ?, ?)\n      &#96;;\n      const result = await this.db.query(sql, [projectId, sourceInformationId, notes || null]);\n      return (result as any).changes &gt; 0 || (result as any).lastID !== undefined;\n    } catch (error) {\n      // 如果表不存在或操作失败，返回 false\n      console.warn('addSourceInformation: SourceInformation table may not exist, returning false', error);\n      return false;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 从项目移除来源信息\n   * 注意：SourceInformation 功能已移除，此方法返回 false\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class SourceInformationService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 创建来源信息\n   */\n  async createSourceInformation(data: CreateSourceInformationDTO): Promise&lt;SourceInformation&gt; {\n    // 检查source_id是否已存在（只检查活跃状态的记录）\n    const existing = await this.model.findBySourceId(data.source_id);\n    if (existing &amp;&amp; existing.status === 'active') {\n      // 如果已存在且是活跃状态，更新而不是创建\n      const updated = await this.model.updateBySourceId(data.source_id, data);\n      if (!updated) {\n        throw new Error('更新来源信息失败');\n      }\n      \n      // 如果提供了 project_id，确保关联存在\n      if (data.project_id &amp;&amp; updated.id) {\n        await this.model.createProjectAssociation(data.project_id, updated.id);\n      }\n      \n      return updated;\n    }\n    \n    // 如果记录不存在或者是已删除状态，创建新记录\n    // 如果已删除的记录存在，先物理删除它，然后创建新记录\n    if (existing &amp;&amp; existing.status === 'deleted') {\n      // 物理删除已删除的记录，避免重复\n      await this.model.hardDelete(existing.id);\n    }\n    \n    const created = await this.model.create(data);\n    \n    // 如果提供了 project_id，创建项目关联\n    if (data.project_id &amp;&amp; created.id) {\n      await this.model.createProjectAssociation(data.project_id, created.id);\n    }\n    \n    return created;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID获取来源信息\n   */\n  async getSourceInformationById(id: number): Promise&lt;SourceInformation | null&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "-- 项目数据管理重构迁移脚本\n-- 创建日期: 2025-12-05\n-- 说明: 重构项目数据管理架构，以\"项目\"为核心关联所有相关数据\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 1. 确保 projects 表存在（如果不存在则创建）\n-- ==============================================\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS projects (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    description TEXT,\n    cover_image TEXT,\n    icon TEXT,\n    type TEXT DEFAULT 'normal' CHECK (type IN ('normal', 'featured')),\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n    created_by TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    last_opened_at DATETIME\n);\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 2. 项目关联基础信息表（多对多关系）\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 项目与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(project_id, tech_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 项目与公开知识点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_knowledge_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    knowledge_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (knowledge_point_id) REFERENCES knowledge_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(project_id, knowledge_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 项目与文件关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_files (\n    ",

        },
        "contents": "-- 迁移脚本：为 tech_points 表添加 TPD2 同步相关字段\n-- 执行日期：2025-12-08\n-- 说明：添加 tpd_id, car_models_info, resources_info 字段，实现单表管理\n\n-- SQLite 版本\n-- 注意：SQLite 不支持直接 ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN 添加多个列，需要逐个添加\n\n-- 1. 添加 tpd_id 字段（用于存储 TPD2 项目的原始 ID，作为同步锚点）\nALTER TABLE tech_points ADD COLUMN tpd_id VARCHAR(100);\n\n-- 2. 添加 car_models_info 字段（JSON 格式存储车型信息）\nALTER TABLE tech_points ADD COLUMN car_models_info TEXT;\n\n-- 3. 添加 resources_info 字段（JSON 格式存储资源信息）\nALTER TABLE tech_points ADD COLUMN resources_info TEXT;\n\n-- 4. 添加 knowledge_info 字段（JSON 格式存储知识点详情，整合现有字段）\nALTER TABLE tech_points ADD COLUMN knowledge_info TEXT;\n\n-- 5. 为 tpd_id 创建索引（用于快速查找和同步）\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tech_points_tpd_id ON tech_points(tpd_id);\n\n-- PostgreSQL 版本（如果需要）\n-- 注意：PostgreSQL 支持一次添加多个列\n/*\nALTER TABLE tech_points \n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS tpd_id VARCHAR(100),\n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS car_models_info JSONB,\n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS resources_info JSONB,\n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_info JSONB;\n\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tech_points_tpd_id ON tech_points(tpd_id);\n*/",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "-- 为 conversations 表添加 project_id 字段\n-- 用于关联对话与项目\n-- 创建日期: 2025-01-XX\n\n-- 添加 project_id 字段（如果不存在）\n-- SQLite 不支持直接检查列是否存在，需要先尝试添加\n-- 如果列已存在，会报错但可以忽略\n\n-- 方法1: 使用 ALTER TABLE（SQLite 3.2.0+）\nALTER TABLE conversations ADD COLUMN project_id INTEGER;\n\n-- 创建索引以提高查询性能\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_conversations_project_id ON conversations(project_id);\n\n-- 可选：添加外键约束（如果数据库支持）\n-- SQLite 3.37.0+ 支持 ALTER TABLE ADD CONSTRAINT\n-- 注意：SQLite 的外键约束需要先启用 PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;\n-- FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE SET NULL",

        "contents": "export class SourceInformationModel {\nasync findByProjectId(projectId: number): Promise&lt;SourceInformation[]&gt; {\n\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // 方式2: 通过关联表查询\n      try {\n        const sql2 = &#96;\n          SELECT si.* FROM source_information si\n          INNER JOIN project_source_informations psi ON si.id = psi.source_information_id\n          WHERE psi.project_id = ? AND si.status = 'active'\n          ORDER BY si.created_at DESC\n        &#96;;\n        const result2 = await this.db.query(sql2, [projectId]);\n        const rows2 = Array.isArray(result2) ? result2 : [result2];\n        for (const row of rows2) {\n          const parsed = this.parseJsonFields(row) as SourceInformation;\n          if (parsed.id &amp;&amp; !seenIds.has(parsed.id)) {\n            results.push(parsed);\n            seenIds.add(parsed.id);\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        // 如果关联表不存在，忽略错误\n        if (!error?.message?.includes('no such table: project_source_informations') &amp;&amp;\n            !error?.message?.includes('relation \"project_source_informations\" does not exist')) {\n          console.warn('查询关联表失败:', error?.message);\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // 方式3: 通过 page_type 查询（兼容旧数据）\n      try {\n        const sql3 = &#96;\n          SELECT * FROM source_information\n          WHERE page_type = ? AND status = 'active'\n          ORDER BY created_at DESC\n        &#96;;\n        const result3 = await this.db.query(sql3, [pageType]);\n        const rows3 = Array.isArray(result3) ? result3 : [result3];\n        for (const row of rows3) {\n          const parsed = this.parseJsonFields(row) as SourceInformation;\n          if (parsed.id &amp;&amp; !seenIds.has(parsed.id)) {\n            results.push(parsed);\n            seenIds.add(parsed.id);\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        console.warn('查询 page_type 失败:', error?.message);\n      }\n      \n      // 按创建时间排序\n      results.sort\n\n  }\n}",

## 修复内容

- 新增 `ensureProjectIdColumn()` 方法
- 检查 `project_id` 字段是否存在
- 不存在时自动添加字段和索引
